vbt-p01-v01.quick_english: Heard O Lord by me all, Rudrayāmala-born; Trika-division wholly, from essence essence-division-wise.

vbt-p01-v02.quick_english: Even now not dispelled of me doubt, O highest Lord; what form in truth O god, word-heap-digit-made-of?

vbt-p01-v03.quick_english: What or by nine-self division, in Bhairava in Bhairava-form; split by three-head division or, what or power-triad-natured?

vbt-p01-v04.quick_english: Nāda-drop-made or even, what moon-crescent-blockers; mounted on wheel unsmeared, or what or power-formed?

vbt-p01-v05.quick_english: Of higher-lower whole, of lower and or again; of higher if like that may be, higher-ness then is contradicted.

vbt-p01-v06.quick_english: Not for by letter division, by body division or may be; higher-ness by partlessness, in wholeness not that may be.

vbt-p01-v07.quick_english: Grace make to me O lord, wholly cut doubt — good good by you asked, tantra-essence this O dear.

vbt-p01-v08.quick_english: Most to be hidden O lucky lady, yet I tell to you; whatever whole form of Bhairava proclaimed.

vbt-p01-v09.quick_english: That by unsubstantialness O Goddess to be known, like Indra-net; like māyā-dream and indeed, gandharva-city-wandering.

vbt-p01-v10.quick_english: For meditation's sake, of confused minds, of rite-pomp dwellers — merely described for men, whose selves struck by fancy.

vbt-p02-v11.quick_english: In truth not nine-self that, word-heap not Bhairava; not and that three-headed god, not and power-triad-natured.

vbt-p02-v12.quick_english: Nāda-drop made or even, not moon-crescent blockers; not wheel-course joined, not and power-formed.

vbt-p02-v13.quick_english: Of unawakened minds indeed these strong terrors; like mother's sweet, all for proceeding's sake declared.

vbt-p02-v14.quick_english: Direction-time-count free, place-point unspecified; to point out unable that, untellable ultimately.

vbt-p02-v15.quick_english: Inner self-taste joy, undirected by fancy's range; which state full-formed, Bhairavī of Bhairava-self.

vbt-p02-v16.quick_english: That body in truth to be known, stainless world-filling; in such supreme reality, who to be worshipped and which pleased?

vbt-p02-v17.quick_english: Thus formed of Bhairava which state is fully sung; she supreme as supreme form, supreme goddess proclaimed.

vbt-p02-v18.quick_english: Of power and powerful as which non-difference always standing; hence from that-property-bearer-ness, supreme power of supreme self.

vbt-p02-v19.quick_english: Not of fire burning power separate is conceived; mere in knowing being beginning this on entering.

vbt-p02-v20.quick_english: Of entered into power-state, without division contemplation; then he Śiva-formed may be, Śaivī mouth here is told.

vbt-p03-v21.quick_english: As by world-light of lamp, by rays and of sun; is known direction-division etc, like that by power, Śiva O dear.

vbt-p03-v22.quick_english: God of gods, trident-marked, skull-made-ornamented; direction-place-time-void and, designation-free.

vbt-p03-v23.quick_english: Which state full-formed of Bhairava is got; by which means door of him, supreme O Goddess how may be? As rightly I know, so to me tell O Bhairava.

vbt-p03-v24.quick_english: Above breath, indeed below living, emission-natured should utter forth; at two arising places, from filling filled standing.

vbt-p03-v25.quick_english: Of wind inside outside or even, from not turning of sky-pair; by Bhairavī of Bhairava thus, O Bhairavī manifested form.

vbt-p03-v26.quick_english: Not should go, not should enter, power wind-formed when blossomed; by thoughtlessness in middle, by her Bhairava-form-ness.

vbt-p03-v27.quick_english: Kumbhaka-held, exhaled or even, inhaled or when may be; at its end called calm this, by power calm shines forth.

vbt-p03-v28.quick_english: From root ray-shining, from subtle subtler-natured; should contemplate her at twelve-end, calming down, Bhairava-rise.

vbt-p03-v29.quick_english: Rising up lightning-formed, wheel by wheel in order step; upwards three fists until, then at end great rise.

vbt-p03-v30.quick_english: Twelvefold course rightly, twelve-letter divided; by gross-subtle-supreme standing, having freed, having freed at end, Śiva.

vbt-p04-v31.quick_english: By that quick filling, to crown-end having broken, by brow-toss bridge; thought-free mind having made, above all, all go forth.

vbt-p04-v32.quick_english: With peacock feathers, with varied forms, with circles, five-void; of meditating, in unsurpassed, in void, entry in heart may be.

vbt-p04-v33.quick_english: By such course indeed, where anywhere thought; in void, on wall, on supreme, on vessel, self dissolved, boon-giving.

vbt-p04-v34.quick_english: Inside skull mind having placed, standing half-closed-eyed; in order from mind's firmness, should mark to-be-marked, highest.

vbt-p04-v35.quick_english: Middle channel, mid-standing, lotus-fibre-like; by meditated inner sky, O Goddess, by that god shines forth.

vbt-p04-v36.quick_english: By hand-blocked gaze-weapon, from brow-split, from door-blocking; when seen in drop, in order when dissolved, in that middle supreme standing.

vbt-p04-v37.quick_english: Dwelling-inner-churn-arisen subtle-fire sect-mark, drop at crest-end, in heart, at dissolution-end; of meditating, dissolving.

vbt-p04-v38.quick_english: In unstruck, in vessel-ear, in broken sound, in river-rushing; in word-brahman bathed, supreme brahman attains.

vbt-p04-v39.quick_english: From oṃ etc prolonged uttering, at prolonged end, from void contemplating; by void, by supreme power, to voidness goes, O Bhairavī.

vbt-p04-v40.quick_english: Of which anyone of letter, first and end should perceive; by void become void he, void-formed man may be.

vbt-p05-v41.quick_english: In string-etc sounding instruments, in longs of ordered abiding; with undivided mind at each end, supreme-sky-body may be.

vbt-p05-v42.quick_english: Of body-mantra of all, by gross-letter course but; half-moon-drop-sound-ending from void uttering, may become Śiva.

vbt-p05-v43.quick_english: In own body all directions at once should contemplate sky; undirected mind, of him sky all proceeds.

vbt-p05-v44.quick_english: Back-void, root-void at once should contemplate, and who; by body-disregarding power, void-minded may be.

vbt-p05-v45.quick_english: Back-void, root-void, heart-void should contemplate steady; at once from thoughtlessness, thoughtless-rising then.

vbt-p05-v46.quick_english: On body-place, voidness indeed, mere moment should envision; thoughtless, thoughtless, sharing thoughtless nature.

vbt-p05-v47.quick_english: All gone in body stuff, sky-pervaded, O deer-eyed lady; should envision then, of him contemplation she steady may be.

vbt-p05-v48.quick_english: Inside body skin-division, become wall should think through; not anything inside, of him meditating, unmeditated-sharer may be.

vbt-p05-v49.quick_english: In heart-sky, hidden-eyed, gone mid lotus-casket; undivided-minded, O lucky lady, supreme fortune may win.

vbt-p05-v50.quick_english: From all of own body, at twelve-end, from mind-dissolving; of firm-minded made firm, reality-mark proceeds.

vbt-p06-v51.quick_english: As thus where there, at twelve-end mind should cast; moment by moment, of wasted turning strangeness, in days becomes.

vbt-p06-v52.quick_english: By time-fire, from time-place arisen, own city burnt should think; at end calm-shining, then may be.

vbt-p06-v53.quick_english: Thus indeed world all burnt having meditated, from fancy; in non-other mind of man, man-ness supreme may be.

vbt-p06-v54.quick_english: In own body, of world or even minute-minuter things and realities which abiding, having meditated at end is manifested supreme.

vbt-p06-v55.quick_english: Thin and weak power having meditated, at twelve-range; having entered, in heart meditating, freed from freedom may win.

vbt-p06-v56.quick_english: World-course-etc-formed should think, in order all; gross-subtle-supreme standing, as long as at end mind-dissolving.

vbt-p06-v57.quick_english: Of this, of all, of world at ends everywhere; by path-procedure reality Śaiva having meditated, great rise.

vbt-p06-v58.quick_english: Universe this, great goddess, void-become should think; right there and mind merged, then of that merging vessel.

vbt-p06-v59.quick_english: In pot-etc vessel, gaze — wall having left, having cast well; at that dissolving in that moment gone, at that dissolving made-of-that may be.

vbt-p06-v60.quick_english: In treeless mountain-wall-etc place, gaze should cast well; when dissolved in mind, in state, of turning-wasted is born.

vbt-p07-v61.quick_english: Of two, of states, in knowing having meditated, middle should resort to; at once and two having left, in middle reality shines forth.

vbt-p07-v62.quick_english: In state, when abandoned, restrained consciousness not indeed to other state may go; then in that middle being, expands exceedingly contemplation.

vbt-p07-v63.quick_english: All body consciousness-made, indeed world or, should fancy fully; at once by undivided, by mind supreme rise.

vbt-p07-v64.quick_english: Of two winds, from clashing, inside or outside at end; yogin, of evenness-knowing rising, offer-vessel.

vbt-p07-v65.quick_english: All world, own body or, with own-bliss filled should remember; at once with own nectar indeed, full of supreme bliss may be.

vbt-p07-v66.quick_english: By trick, by application, at once indeed, O deer-eyed; manifests great bliss, by which reality shines forth.

vbt-p07-v67.quick_english: By all-channel binding, by up-going breath-power, slowly; at ant-crawling time, spreads forth supreme happiness.

vbt-p07-v68.quick_english: Of fire, of poison, in middle, but mind happiness-made should cast; mere wind-filled, or by remembrance-bliss is yoked.

vbt-p07-v69.quick_english: Agitated by union, shaking, by power-penetration final; whatever happiness of brahman-reality, that happiness own-told is told.

vbt-p07-v70.quick_english: By licking, churning, pounding, of woman-bliss from fullness, of memory; in power-absence even, O goddess of gods, may be bliss-flood.

vbt-p08-v71.quick_english: In joy, in great, when got, seen or kinsman long after; bliss risen having meditated, in that dissolved, of that mind may be.

vbt-p08-v72.quick_english: From eating-drinking-swelling-joy-bliss-blooming, should fancy filled state; great bliss, then may be.

vbt-p08-v73.quick_english: From song-etc object-tasting, not-shared happiness one-selfness; of yogin, by absorbedness, in mind mounted, in that selfness.

vbt-p08-v74.quick_english: Where where mind content, mind right there should hold; there there supreme-bliss-own-form proceeds forth.

vbt-p08-v75.quick_english: In not-yet-come, in sleep, when perished outer range; that state by mind to be gone to, supreme goddess shines forth.

vbt-p08-v76.quick_english: By brilliance of sun, lamp, etc, in dappled sky; gaze to be fixed right there, own self-form shines forth.

vbt-p08-v77.quick_english: By skeleton, by angry, by licking Bhairavī, by sky-going; at gaze-time and supreme attainment shines forth.

vbt-p08-v78.quick_english: On soft seat, with one buttock, hands feet unsupported having placed; by that context supreme full mind may be.

vbt-p08-v79.quick_english: Having sat on seat rightly, two arms having made half-bent; in armpit-sky mind making calm, comes by that dissolving.

vbt-p08-v80.quick_english: Of gross-formed state fixed gaze having cast down, and quickly unsupported mind having made, Śiva may go.

vbt-p09-v81.quick_english: On middle tongue, in opened mouth, in middle having cast awareness; h-uttering by mind making, then in calm dissolves.

vbt-p09-v82.quick_english: On seat, on bed having stood, unsupported envisioning; own body in mind, when wasted in a moment, wasted-impurity may be.

vbt-p09-v83.quick_english: On moving seat, of standing now, slowly or from body moving; in calmed, in mind, in state, O Goddess, divine flood may win.

vbt-p09-v84.quick_english: Sky stainless seeing, having made gaze unbroken; stunned self, at that moment O Goddess, Bhairava form may win.

vbt-p09-v85.quick_english: Dissolved on crown, sky all as Bhairava should contemplate; that all, Bhairava-form-blaze reality may enter.

vbt-p09-v86.quick_english: Something known, duality-giving, outer light, darkness again; universe etc Bhairava form, having known endless-light-bearing.

vbt-p09-v87.quick_english: Thus indeed in bad night, on dark fortnight arrival long; Timira contemplating form, Bhairava form will go to.

vbt-p09-v88.quick_english: Thus indeed having closed first, eyes black lustre before; having spread Bhairava form contemplating, made of that may be.

vbt-p09-v89.quick_english: Of whose any organ even, from striking and from blocking; of entered in nondual, in void, there itself self shines forth.

vbt-p09-v90.quick_english: No drop, no emission, and a-syllable of muttering great; rises O Goddess suddenly, knowledge-flood highest Lord.

vbt-p10-v91.quick_english: Of letter with emission, emission-ending awareness make; by supportless mind may touch brahma eternal.

vbt-p10-v92.quick_english: Sky-formed own self should meditate, by directions uncovered; supportless awareness power, own form will show then.

vbt-p10-v93.quick_english: Something limb having pierced first with sharp needle etc, then; right there awareness having yoked, in Bhairava spotless going.

vbt-p10-v94.quick_english: Mind-etc inner-making not is inside me, should contemplate thus; by absence of fancies, by fancies abandoned may be.

vbt-p10-v95.quick_english: māyā deluding named, of part counting standing; such-etc nature of realities counting, not separately may be.

vbt-p10-v96.quick_english: Sudden desire arisen, having seen, to calm should lead; where indeed arisen, thence right there dissolves.

vbt-p10-v97.quick_english: When my desire unarisen, knowing or why, then I am indeed; truly He-I, thus become, in that dissolved, that-minded may be.

vbt-p10-v98.quick_english: In desire or, in knowing when arisen, mind should set; self-mind undivided-minded, then reality-meaning seeing.

vbt-p10-v99.quick_english: Causeless may be, knowing supportless error-natured; truly of anyone not this, thus becoming Siva, O dear.

vbt-p10-v100.quick_english: Consciousness-natured, in all bodies distinction not is anywhere; hence and made of that all contemplating, world-conquering person.

vbt-p11-v101.quick_english: In lust-anger-greed-delusion-pride-envy range, intellect uncaused having made, that reality remains.

vbt-p11-v102.quick_english: Indra-net-made world, cast or picture-work-like; whirling or, of meditating all, of seeing, and joy upsurge.

vbt-p11-v103.quick_english: Not mind should cast in pain, not in joy, or scatter around; O Bhairavi, may be known in middle what reality remains.

vbt-p11-v104.quick_english: Having left own-body-standing, everywhere-I-am-thus contemplating; with firm mind, by gaze not seeing else, happy may be.

vbt-p11-v105.quick_english: In pot etc whatever and knowing, desire etc or inside me; never all-pervading born contemplating, thus all-going.

vbt-p11-v106.quick_english: Grasper-grasped awareness common of all embodied; of yogins but distinction: He is, in relation carefulness.

vbt-p11-v107.quick_english: Like self in other body, He even awareness should perceive; regard of own body having left, pervasive in days may be.

vbt-p11-v108.quick_english: Supportless mind having made, thoughts not should think; then self-supreme-self in, Bhairava, O deer-eyed.

vbt-p11-v109.quick_english: All-knowing, all-doing, and pervasive highest-Lord; he indeed I, Siva-natured, thus from firmness Siva may be.

vbt-p11-v110.quick_english: Like water waves, of fire flame-plays, light of sun; of me indeed, of Bhairava these world-plays manifested.

vbt-p12-v111.quick_english: Having whirled, having whirled, by body swiftly on earth from falling; by agitation-power ceasing, supreme is born state.

vbt-p12-v112.quick_english: On supports or by power, by knowing, from mind-dissolving or; born power-penetration agitation-end, Bhairava form.

vbt-p12-v113.quick_english: Tradition this, O Goddess hear, rightly I tell — even freedom is born at once, when the eyes are unwinkingly fixed.

vbt-p12-v114.quick_english: Contraction of ears having made, indeed at lower gate likewise and; unsmeared, unploughed, meditating should enter brahma eternal.

vbt-p12-v115.quick_english: At well etc, in great pit, having stood above from looking; of undivided mind rightly, at once mind-dissolving plainly.

vbt-p12-v116.quick_english: Where where mind goes, outside or inside or even or; there there Śiva-state, by pervasiveness, where will it go?

vbt-p12-v117.quick_english: Where where-eye-road-by, consciousness is manifested of the pervader; of him, from only-that-natured, from cit-dissolving, full-self-ness.

vbt-p12-v118.quick_english: At hunger etc end, in fear, in grief, in abyss or battle fled, having fled; at curiosity-thirst etc end, reality-being-full state.

vbt-p12-v119.quick_english: In things being remembered, when seen, in place mind should leave; own body unsupported having made, spreads forth lord.

vbt-p12-v120.quick_english: Anywhere on thing having placed, slowly gaze withdraw; that knowing mind-with, O Goddess, void-abode may be.

vbt-p13-v121.quick_english: From devotion excess, of dispassionate, as which arises mind; she power, Śaṅkara's, always should contemplate her, then Śiva.

vbt-p13-v122.quick_english: In thing inside, being known, in all things voidness; her indeed by mind having meditated, known even becomes calm.

vbt-p13-v123.quick_english: By slightly knowing which remembered purity, that purity in Śambhu view; not pure indeed impure, therefore thought-free happy may be.

vbt-p13-v124.quick_english: Everywhere Bhairava state, in common things even object; not and apart from that higher is thus, nondual going.

vbt-p13-v125.quick_english: Same in enemy and in friend and, same in honor dishonor; of brahma from fullness, thus having known, happy may be.

vbt-p13-v126.quick_english: Not hatred should think anywhere, not passion should think somewhere; in freedom from passion hatred, in middle brahma glides forth.

vbt-p13-v127.quick_english: Which unknowable, which ungraspable, which void, which gone to nonbeing; that all Bhairava to be contemplated, at that end awakening arising.

vbt-p13-v128.quick_english: In eternal, in supportless, in void, in pervasive, in calculation-free; in outer sky mind having made, into skyless should enter.

vbt-p13-v129.quick_english: Where where mind goes, that that by that itself at that moment; having left non-standing, waveless then may be.

vbt-p13-v130.quick_english: By fear, all makes resound, giving all, pervasive in wholeness; thus of Bhairava-word, from constant uttering, Śiva.

vbt-p14-v131.quick_english: I, mine-this, etc, from coming to conviction; in supportless mind goes, from that meditation impulse, calm.

vbt-p14-v132.quick_english: Eternal, all-pervading, supportless, pervasive, and all-lord; words moment by moment meditating, done aim according to meaning.

vbt-p14-v133.quick_english: Non-reality, indra-net-shine, this all standing; what reality of indra-net, thus from firmness calm may go.

vbt-p14-v134.quick_english: Of self unwavering, where knowing, where and or action; knowing-dependent outer states, hence void this world.

vbt-p14-v135.quick_english: Not of me bondage, not freedom of me, of frightened-these terrors; reflection this of intellect in waters, like of sun.

vbt-p14-v136.quick_english: Sense-doored all, pleasure-pain-etc meeting, thus senses having left, self-abiding in own self abides.

vbt-p14-v137.quick_english: Knowing-lighting all, by all self lighting; one, from one-nature-ness, knowing knowable is envisioned.

vbt-p14-v138.quick_english: Mental, consciousness, power, self and mind fourfold; when, O dear, fully wasted, then that Bhairava form.

vbt-p14-v139.quick_english: Of waveless teachings hundred told in brief; twelve-plus, O Goddess, which having known, knowing knower person.

vbt-p14-v140.quick_english: Here and in one yoked, becomes Bhairava himself; by speech does deeds, curse-favor making.

vbt-p15-v141.quick_english: Ageless deathlessness attains he, with atom-etc-qualities-endowed; of yoginīs dear, O Goddess, all-gathering lord.

vbt-p15-v142.quick_english: Living even, freed he, doing even, not is smeared; this if body, O god, of supreme and great lord.

vbt-p15-v143.quick_english: In thus told state, is muttered who muttering, and who; is meditated who, O great lord, is worshipped, who and is pleased.

vbt-p15-v144.quick_english: Is offered of whom or oblation, sacrifice of whom, and what how; this here procedure outer, in gross things indeed, O deer-eyed.

vbt-p15-v145.quick_english: Again again in supreme state, contemplation is contemplated indeed, which; muttering that there, self sound, mantra-natured to be muttered, such.

vbt-p15-v146.quick_english: Meditation indeed unmoving intellect, formless, supportless; not but meditation body-eye-mouth-hand etc imagining.

vbt-p15-v147.quick_english: Worship named, not with flowers etc which mind is made firm; in undifferentiated, in great sky, that worship indeed from care dissolving.

vbt-p15-v148.quick_english: Here in one or another practice standing, when may arise from day to day; full-formed state, right here contentment, utter fullness.

vbt-p15-v149.quick_english: In great void abode, in fire, being sense object etc; is offered by mind, with all oblation, with awareness ladle.

vbt-p15-v150.quick_english: Sacrifice here, O highest lady, contentment bliss-marked; from wasting all sins, from protecting all, O mountain's daughter.

vbt-p16-v151.quick_english: Rudra-power-penetration, that field, contemplation supreme; otherwise of him, of reality, what worship, what and is pleased.

vbt-p16-v152.quick_english: Free-bliss-consciousness-mere essence, own self indeed everywhere; entering in that form, of own self bath declared.

vbt-p16-v153.quick_english: By which indeed is worshipped, with materials is pleased, or higher-lower; who and indeed worshipper, all he very one, where worship?

vbt-p16-v154.quick_english: May go breath, may enter life, by will crooked-formed; long-formed she, great goddess, other field, higher-lower.

vbt-p16-v155.quick_english: In this walking along, standing in great-bliss-made, on path; by her, by goddess entered, supreme Bhairava may attain.

vbt-p16-v156.quick_english: Six hundreds by day, by night thousand twenty-one; muttering of goddess declared, easy hard by dullards.

vbt-p16-v157.quick_english: Thus this told, O Goddess, supreme nectar highest; this and never of anyone to be shown, but ever.

vbt-p16-v158.quick_english: To another pupil, to base, to cruel, to non-devoted, of guru feet; of thought-free-minded but, of heroes, of lofty-souled.

vbt-p16-v159.quick_english: Of devoted, of guru group, to be given without hesitation; village, kingdom, town, country, son wife family.

vbt-p16-v160.quick_english: All this having left, to be grasped this, O deer-eyed; what with these unsteady, O Goddess, steady supreme this wealth; lives even to be given, not to be given supreme nectar.

vbt-p17-v161.quick_english: God of gods, great god, fully content am I, Śaṅkara; of Rudrayāmala tantra, essence today held.

vbt-p17-v162.quick_english: Of all power divisions, heart known today and; thus having spoken delighted, goddess on neck clung, of Śiva but.

vbt-p01-v01.speaker: Devī (declaring)
vbt-p01-v01.question: What have I heard, and how does it divide?
premises: Heard: all, Rudrayāmala-born, Trika-division whole.
Essence distinguished from essence.
vbt-p01-v01.inference: The hearing is declared complete before any doubt opens.

vbt-p01-v02.speaker: Devī (questioning)
vbt-p01-v02.question: What doubt remains, and what is its form?
premises: Even now the doubt is not dispelled.
What form in truth: word-heap-digit-made?
vbt-p01-v02.inference: The doubt sharpens to a form-question about the word-heap.

vbt-p01-v03.speaker: Devī (questioning)
vbt-p01-v03.question: Which form is it truly?
premises: Nine-self division? Bhairava-form? three-head split? power-triad?
vbt-p01-v03.inference: Four candidate forms are flung as alternatives, none yet chosen.

vbt-p01-v04.speaker: Devī (questioning)
vbt-p01-v04.question: Or is it nāda-drop made?
premises: Nāda-drop or moon-crescent-blockers?
Wheel-mounted unsmeared, or power-formed?
vbt-p01-v04.inference: Two more alternatives — the form-question widens to sound and wheel imagery.

vbt-p01-v05.speaker: Devī (doubting)
vbt-p01-v05.question: Can higher-lower even be spoken?
premises: Whole of higher-lower: if higher were like that, higher-ness contradicts itself.
The lower-side formulation collapses on inspection.
vbt-p01-v05.inference: Every attempted formulation threatens the higher's higher-ness — the question eats its answers.

vbt-p01-v06.speaker: Devī (doubting)
vbt-p01-v06.question: Or does higher-ness evade all division?
premises: Not by letter-division, not by body-division.
Higher-ness is partlessness; in wholeness not that.
vbt-p01-v06.inference: Division fails twice — higher-ness abides only as whole partlessness.

vbt-p01-v07.speaker: Devī and Bhairava (turning)
vbt-p01-v07.question: How is the doubt cut?
premises: Grace, O lord: wholly cut the doubt.
Sādhu sādhu: what you asked is the tantra-essence.
vbt-p01-v07.inference: The plea and the praise turn together: the doubt itself is the essence-question.
uncertainties: v7 is the dialogue hinge: Devī's chinddhi saṃśayam + Bhairava's sādhu sādhu in one verse (kept whole)

vbt-p01-v08.speaker: Bhairava (promising)
vbt-p01-v08.question: What will Bhairava tell?
premises: Most-to-be-hidden, yet I tell you.
Whatever whole form of Bhairava proclaimed.
vbt-p01-v08.inference: What is most hidden will be proclaimed — the telling begins anyway.

vbt-p01-v09.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p01-v09.question: How should that form be known?
premises: By unsubstantialness, like Indra-net.
Like māyā-dream, gandharva-city-wandering.
vbt-p01-v09.inference: The form is known only as unsubstantial — dream, net, mirage-city.

vbt-p01-v10.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p01-v10.question: For whom is this merely described?
premises: For meditation's sake: confused minds, rite-pomp dwellers.
Merely described for men, selves struck by fancy.
vbt-p01-v10.inference: Description serves meditation, not pomp — fancy-struck men get words only.

vbt-p02-v11.speaker: Bhairava (denying)
vbt-p02-v11.question: Is it nine-self or word-heap?
premises: In truth: not nine-self, not word-heap, not three-headed god.
vbt-p02-v11.inference: Every creature-form is denied — Bhairava-form exceeds naming.

vbt-p02-v12.speaker: Bhairava (denying)
vbt-p02-v12.question: Is it nāda-drop or wheel-joined?
premises: Not nāda-drop, not moon-crescent blockers, not wheel-course joined.
vbt-p02-v12.inference: Sound-imagery denied too — the power-form is none of its pictures.

vbt-p02-v13.speaker: Bhairava (explaining)
vbt-p02-v13.question: Why such terrors for the unawakened?
premises: These strong terrors of unawakened minds.
Like mother's sweet: all for proceeding's sake declared.
vbt-p02-v13.inference: The terrors are lures — mother's sweet leading the proceeding mind.

vbt-p02-v14.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)
vbt-p02-v14.question: Can it be pointed out?
premises: Direction-time-count free, place-point unspecified.
Unable to point out; untellable ultimately.
vbt-p02-v14.inference: Ultimate unpointability: the form defies designation entirely.

vbt-p02-v15.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)
vbt-p02-v15.question: What state is Bhairavī?
premises: Inner self-taste joy, undirected by fancy's range.
Full-formed state, Bhairavī of Bhairava-self.
vbt-p02-v15.inference: Bhairavī's state is inner-joy beyond fancy — full-formed.

vbt-p02-v16.speaker: Bhairava (questioning)
vbt-p02-v16.question: What is that body, and who worships?
premises: That body in truth: stainless, world-filling.
In such supreme reality, who worships and which pleased?
vbt-p02-v16.inference: The body is stainless world-filling — and worship itself becomes the question.

vbt-p02-v17.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)
vbt-p02-v17.question: Which state of Bhairava is sung?
premises: Which state of Bhairava is fully sung: she is supreme.
As supreme form, supreme goddess proclaimed.
vbt-p02-v17.inference: The sung state is she — supreme goddess in supreme form.

vbt-p02-v18.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)
vbt-p02-v18.question: How do power and powerful stand?
premises: Non-difference always standing between power and powerful.
Hence: supreme power of supreme self, from bearing-property.
vbt-p02-v18.inference: Indivisible power-and-powerful yields the supreme power of supreme self.

vbt-p02-v19.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)
vbt-p02-v19.question: Is fire's burning separate?
premises: Fire's burning-power not separate — conceived not.
Only in knowing-being: this beginning, on entering.
vbt-p02-v19.inference: No separate burning power: entry itself begins it, in knowing-being alone.

vbt-p02-v20.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)
vbt-p02-v20.question: What happens on entering power-state?
premises: In entered power-state, without division contemplation.
Then he Śiva-formed may be; Śaivī mouth is told.
vbt-p02-v20.inference: Undivided contemplation makes him Śiva-formed — that mouth is called Śaivī.

vbt-p03-v21.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)
vbt-p03-v21.question: How is Śiva known by power?
premises: As by lamp's light or sun's rays: direction-division known.
So by power, Śiva, O dear, is known.
vbt-p03-v21.inference: Analogy: just as light reveals directions, power reveals Śiva.

vbt-p03-v22.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)
vbt-p03-v22.question: What does that Śiva look like?
premises: God of gods, trident-marked, skull-ornamented.
Direction-place-time void and designation-free.
vbt-p03-v22.inference: The described form is already void of all designations — description cancels itself.

vbt-p03-v23.speaker: Devī (requesting)
vbt-p03-v23.question: What state is sought, and by which door?
premises: Which full-formed state of Bhairava is got; by which means door?
As I rightly know — tell me, O Bhairava.
vbt-p03-v23.inference: The means-question is begged properly: tell it as you know it, not as it is said.
uncertainties: three-part verse: Bhairava's half + Devī's means-question + her brūhi plea (kept whole)

vbt-p03-v24.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 1)
vbt-p03-v24.question: Where does breath rest?
premises: Above breath, below living, emission-natured uttering forth.
At two arising places: from filling, filled standing.
vbt-p03-v24.inference: Breath meeting-point standing: filling at the two arising places completes the posture.

vbt-p03-v25.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 2)
vbt-p03-v25.question: What is manifested by Bhairavī?
premises: Of wind inside or outside, sky-pair not turning.
By Bhairavī of Bhairava thus: the manifested form.
vbt-p03-v25.inference: By the wind-pair's turning, Bhairavī manifests Bhairava's form.

vbt-p03-v26.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 3)
vbt-p03-v26.question: What happens when the wind-power blossoms?
premises: Power neither goes nor enters when wind-formed blossoms.
By thoughtlessness in middle: by her, Bhairava-form-ness.
vbt-p03-v26.inference: Neither going nor entering — Bhairava-form arises by thoughtlessness.

vbt-p03-v27.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 4)
vbt-p03-v27.question: Which breath-phase brings calm?
premises: Kumbhaka-held, exhaled, or inhaled when may be.
At its end this is called calm: by power, calm shines forth.
vbt-p03-v27.inference: End of any breath-phase is the calm that shines by power.

vbt-p03-v28.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 5)
vbt-p03-v28.question: What should be contemplated?
premises: From root ray-shining, from subtle subtler-natured.
Contemplate her at twelve-end: calming down, Bhairava-rise.
vbt-p03-v28.inference: Contemplating the subtler at the twelve-end, calming, rises Bhairava.

vbt-p03-v29.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 6)
vbt-p03-v29.question: How does it rise?
premises: Up lightning-formed, wheel by wheel in order step.
Upwards three fists until: then at end, great rise.
vbt-p03-v29.inference: The rise steps wheel by wheel to three fists — then the great rise.

vbt-p03-v30.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 7)
vbt-p03-v30.question: What is the course?
premises: Twelvefold course rightly, twelve-letter divided.
By gross-subtle-supreme standing, freed at end: Śiva.
vbt-p03-v30.inference: Passing through gross-subtle-supreme standing, freed at end one is Śiva.

vbt-p04-v31.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 8)
vbt-p04-v31.question: How does the mind go forth?
premises: By quick filling, to crown-end broken, by brow-toss bridge.
Thought-free mind made: above all, all go forth.
vbt-p04-v31.inference: The brow-bridge crossed with thought-free mind, all go forth above.

vbt-p04-v32.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 9)
vbt-p04-v32.question: What aids entry?
premises: Peacock feathers, varied forms, circles: five-void.
Of meditating, in unsurpassed void, entry in heart may be.
vbt-p04-v32.inference: In the unsurpassed void, meditation gives entry in heart.

vbt-p04-v33.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 10)
vbt-p04-v33.question: Where can thought dissolve?
premises: By such course anywhere: void, wall, supreme, vessel.
Self dissolved there — boon-giving.
vbt-p04-v33.inference: Thought dissolves in void, wall, supreme, vessel — self-dissolving gives boons.

vbt-p04-v34.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 11)
vbt-p04-v34.question: What is placed inside the skull?
premises: Inside skull mind placed, standing half-closed-eyed.
In order from mind's firmness: should mark the to-be-marked, highest.
vbt-p04-v34.inference: From mind's firmness the highest mark is marked.

vbt-p04-v35.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 12)
vbt-p04-v35.question: What shines through the middle channel?
premises: Middle channel mid-standing, lotus-fibre-like.
By meditated inner sky, O Goddess, by that god shines forth.
vbt-p04-v35.inference: God shines through the meditated inner sky of the middle channel.

vbt-p04-v36.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 13)
vbt-p04-v36.question: What is seen in the drop?
premises: Hand-blocked gaze from brow-split, from door-blocking.
Seen in drop, dissolved in order: in that middle, supreme standing.
vbt-p04-v36.inference: The drop's middle holds supreme standing when the gaze dissolves.

vbt-p04-v37.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 14)
vbt-p04-v37.question: What is dissolved at the heart?
premises: Subtle-fire sect-mark at crest-end, drop in heart, at dissolution-end.
Of meditating: dissolving.
vbt-p04-v37.inference: Meditating the drop to its dissolution-end IS dissolving.

vbt-p04-v38.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 15)
vbt-p04-v38.question: Where does the knower attain?
premises: In unstruck, vessel-ear, broken sound, river-rushing.
In word-brahman bathed: supreme brahman attains.
vbt-p04-v38.inference: Bathed in word-brahman through those sounds, supreme brahman is attained.

vbt-p04-v39.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 16)
vbt-p04-v39.question: What happens at prolonged oṃ?
premises: From oṃ-etc prolonged uttering, at prolonged end, void contemplating.
By void, by supreme power: to voidness goes, O Bhairavī.
vbt-p04-v39.inference: Prolonged utterance ends in contemplation of void — to voidness she goes.

vbt-p04-v40.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 17)
vbt-p04-v40.question: What does perceiving a letter's ends do?
premises: Of which letter: first and end should perceive.
By void become void he: void-formed man may be.
vbt-p04-v40.inference: Perceiving a letter's two ends through void makes one void-formed.

vbt-p05-v41.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 18)
vbt-p05-v41.question: What sounds seat the undivided mind?
premises: String-etc sounding instruments, in longs of ordered abiding.
With undivided mind at each end: supreme-sky-body may be.
vbt-p05-v41.inference: In the long tone of ordered sound, undivided mind seats the supreme-sky-body.

vbt-p05-v42.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 19)
vbt-p05-v42.question: How does body-mantra end?
premises: Body-mantra of all, by gross-letter course; half-moon-drop-sound-ending.
From void uttering: may become Śiva.
vbt-p05-v42.inference: Void-uttering at the half-moon-drop-sound's end makes Śiva.

vbt-p05-v43.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 20)
vbt-p05-v43.question: Where is sky contemplated?
premises: In own body all directions at once: sky.
Undirected mind: of him, sky all proceeds.
vbt-p05-v43.inference: Undirected mind in own body makes sky proceed all through.

vbt-p05-v44.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 21)
vbt-p05-v44.question: Which voids are contemplated?
premises: Back-void, root-void at once, and who?
By body-disregarding power: void-minded may be.
vbt-p05-v44.inference: Contemplating back- and root-voids through body-disregard, one becomes void-minded.

vbt-p05-v45.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 22)
vbt-p05-v45.question: What rises from thoughtlessness?
premises: Back-void, root-void, heart-void contemplated steady.
At once from thoughtlessness: thoughtless-rising then.
vbt-p05-v45.inference: Steady contemplation of the three voids yields thoughtless-rising.

vbt-p05-v46.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 23)
vbt-p05-v46.question: How long is voidness envisioned?
premises: On body-place, voidness indeed, mere moment should envision.
Thoughtless, thoughtless: sharing thoughtless nature.
vbt-p05-v46.inference: A single moment's envisioning makes one share thoughtless nature.

vbt-p05-v47.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 24)
vbt-p05-v47.question: What settles when all is sky?
premises: All gone in body stuff, sky-pervaded, O deer-eyed lady.
Should envision then: of him contemplation, she steady may be.

vbt-p05-v48.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 25)
vbt-p05-v48.question: What is seen inside the body?
premises: Inside body skin-division: become wall, think through.
Not anything inside: meditating, unmeditated-sharer may be.
vbt-p05-v48.inference: Seeing the skin as wall with nothing inside makes one the unmeditated-sharer.

vbt-p05-v49.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 26)
vbt-p05-v49.question: Where does the mind enter?
premises: In heart-sky, hidden-eyed, gone mid lotus-casket.
Undivided-minded, O lucky lady: supreme fortune may win.
vbt-p05-v49.inference: Mid lotus-casket with undivided mind, supreme fortune is won.

vbt-p05-v50.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 27)
vbt-p05-v50.question: What becomes firm?
premises: From all of own body, at twelve-end, from mind-dissolving.
Of firm-minded made firm: reality-mark proceeds.
vbt-p05-v50.inference: Mind-dissolving at the twelve-end sets the reality-mark firm.

vbt-p06-v51.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 28)
vbt-p06-v51.question: Where must the mind be cast?
premises: As thus where there, at twelve-end mind should cast.
Moment by moment: of wasted turning strangeness, in days becomes.
vbt-p06-v51.inference: Cast at the twelve-end moment by moment, strangeness wears away in days.

vbt-p06-v52.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 29)
vbt-p06-v52.question: What burns?
premises: By time-fire from time-place arisen: own city burnt.
At end calm-shining, then may be.
vbt-p06-v52.inference: Burning the city in time-fire ends in calm-shining.

vbt-p06-v53.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 30)
vbt-p06-v53.question: What remains after burning?
premises: Thus world all burnt, having meditated, from fancy.
In non-other mind of man: man-ness supreme may be.
vbt-p06-v53.inference: Fancy-burned world leaves only man-ness supreme in the non-other mind.

vbt-p06-v54.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 31)
vbt-p06-v54.question: Where is the supreme manifested?
premises: In own body, world or even minute-minuter things and realities.
Having meditated at end: is manifested supreme.
vbt-p06-v54.inference: Meditating the minutest realities in own body manifests the supreme.

vbt-p06-v55.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 32)
vbt-p06-v55.question: What does the weak power do?
premises: Thin and weak power meditated at twelve-range.
Having entered in heart meditating: freed from freedom may win.
vbt-p06-v55.inference: Entering heart with the weak power at the twelve-range wins freedom.

vbt-p06-v56.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 33)
vbt-p06-v56.question: What is contemplated in order?
premises: World-course-etc formed, in order all.
Gross-subtle-supreme standing, as long as at end mind-dissolving.
vbt-p06-v56.inference: The ordered world-course runs to the end where mind dissolves.

vbt-p06-v57.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 34)
vbt-p06-v57.question: Where does the great rise come from?
premises: Of this, of all, of world at ends everywhere.
By path-procedure reality Śaiva meditated: great rise.
vbt-p06-v57.inference: Meditating Śiva-reality by path-procedure at world's ends gives the great rise.

vbt-p06-v58.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 35)
vbt-p06-v58.question: How is the universe voided?
premises: Universe this, great goddess: void-become should think.
Right there and mind merged: then of that merging vessel.
vbt-p06-v58.inference: Void-thinking merges the mind — one becomes the vessel of that merging.

vbt-p06-v59.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 36)
vbt-p06-v59.question: Where does gaze rest?
premises: In pot-etc vessel, gaze: wall left, cast well.
At that dissolving in that moment gone: made-of-that may be.
vbt-p06-v59.inference: Cast well beyond the wall, at dissolution one becomes made-of-that.

vbt-p06-v60.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 37)
vbt-p06-v60.question: What is born when mind dissolves?
premises: In treeless mountain-wall-etc place, gaze cast well.
When dissolved in mind: of turning-wasted is born.
vbt-p06-v60.inference: Where mind dissolves, the wasting of turning is born out.

vbt-p07-v61.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 38)
vbt-p07-v61.question: Which middle is resorted to?
premises: Of two, of states, in knowing meditated: middle resort to.
At once and two left: in middle, reality shines forth.
vbt-p07-v61.inference: Leaving both states for the middle, reality shines forth at once.

vbt-p07-v62.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 39)
vbt-p07-v62.question: What expands in the middle?
premises: In state abandoned, restrained consciousness not to other state.
Then in that middle-being: contemplation expands exceedingly.
vbt-p07-v62.inference: Restrained from all other states, contemplation expands exceedingly in the middle.

vbt-p07-v63.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 40)
vbt-p07-v63.question: How does the supreme rise come?
premises: All body consciousness-made, or world, fancy fully.
At once by undivided mind: supreme rise.
vbt-p07-v63.inference: Undivided fancy of all-body-as-consciousness yields supreme rise.

vbt-p07-v64.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 41)
vbt-p07-v64.question: Where do the two winds meet?
premises: Of two winds, from clashing, inside or outside at end.
Yogin: of evenness-knowing rising, offer-vessel.
vbt-p07-v64.inference: The meeting-place is where evenness-knowing rises — the yogin is that vessel.

vbt-p07-v65.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 42)
vbt-p07-v65.question: What is remembered at once?
premises: All world, own body or, with own-bliss filled.
At once with own nectar: full of supreme bliss may be.
vbt-p07-v65.inference: Remembering filled with own bliss/nector, one becomes full of supreme bliss.

vbt-p07-v66.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 43)
vbt-p07-v66.question: How does great bliss manifest?
premises: By trick, by application, at once, O deer-eyed.
Manifests great bliss: by which reality shines forth.
vbt-p07-v66.inference: Applied technique manifests great bliss — and through it reality shines.

vbt-p07-v67.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 44)
vbt-p07-v67.question: How does supreme happiness spread?
premises: By all-channel binding, by up-going breath-power, slowly.
At ant-crawling time: spreads forth supreme happiness.
vbt-p07-v67.inference: Slowly, bound channel by channel, supreme happiness spreads at the crawler's pace.

vbt-p07-v68.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 45)
vbt-p07-v68.question: Where is mind cast amid fire and poison?
premises: Of fire, of poison, in middle: mind happiness-made cast.
Mere wind-filled, or by remembrance-bliss yoked.
vbt-p07-v68.inference: Cast happiness-made between fire and poison, mind yokes by remembrance-bliss.

vbt-p07-v69.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 46)
vbt-p07-v69.question: What happiness is truly told?
premises: Agitated by union, shaking, by power-penetration final.
Whatever happiness of brahman-reality: that own-told is told.
vbt-p07-v69.inference: Only the brahman-reality's happiness, own-told, is the happiness to tell.

vbt-p07-v70.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 47)
vbt-p07-v70.question: What overflows from memory?
premises: By licking, churning, pounding, of woman-bliss from fullness, of memory.
In power-absence even, O goddess: may be bliss-flood.
vbt-p07-v70.inference: Memory of that fullness overflows into bliss-flood even without power.
uncertainties: dhāraṇā 47; lehana kept literal (licking/tasting, per Roche)

vbt-p08-v71.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 48)
vbt-p08-v71.question: What mind may be in bliss?
premises: In joy, in great, when got, seen or kinsman long after.
Bliss risen having meditated: of that dissolved mind may be.
vbt-p08-v71.inference: Meditating risen bliss, dissolved into it, one's mind may be that.

vbt-p08-v72.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 49)
vbt-p08-v72.question: What is the filled state?
premises: From eating-drinking-swelling-joy-bliss-blooming.
Should fancy filled state: great bliss then may be.
vbt-p08-v72.inference: Fancying the filled state at joy's blooming yields great bliss.

vbt-p08-v73.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 50)
vbt-p08-v73.question: Where does the yogin's self merge?
premises: From song-etc object-tasting: not-shared happiness one-selfness.
Of yogin by absorbedness: in mind mounted, in that selfness.
vbt-p08-v73.inference: Absorbedness mounted in mind turns tasted happiness into one-selfness.

vbt-p08-v74.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 51)
vbt-p08-v74.question: Where must the mind be held?
premises: Where mind content: mind right there should hold.
There there: supreme-bliss-own-form proceeds forth.
vbt-p08-v74.inference: Holding content mind exactly there, supreme-bliss-own-form proceeds.

vbt-p08-v75.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 52)
vbt-p08-v75.question: What state comes before sleep?
premises: In not-yet-come, in sleep, when perished outer range.
That state by mind to be gone to: supreme goddess shines forth.
vbt-p08-v75.inference: At sleep's outer range, going by mind into that state, the supreme goddess shines.

vbt-p08-v76.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 53)
vbt-p08-v76.question: Where is gaze fixed?
premises: By brilliance of sun, lamp, etc, in dappled sky.
Gaze fixed right there: own self-form shines forth.
vbt-p08-v76.inference: Fixed in the dappled sky, own self-form shines forth.

vbt-p08-v77.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 54)
vbt-p08-v77.question: What brings supreme attainment?
premises: By skeleton, by angry, by licking Bhairavī, by sky-going.
At gaze-time: supreme attainment shines forth.
vbt-p08-v77.inference: Even in those fierce gaze-times, supreme attainment shines.

vbt-p08-v78.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 55)
vbt-p08-v78.question: How should one sit?
premises: On soft seat, one buttock: hands feet unsupported placed.
By that context: supreme full mind may be.
vbt-p08-v78.inference: The asymmetric unsupported seat makes mind supreme and full.

vbt-p08-v79.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 56)
vbt-p08-v79.question: What calm comes from the arms?
premises: Having sat rightly: two arms half-bent.
In armpit-sky mind making calm: comes by that dissolving.
vbt-p08-v79.inference: Mind in the armpit-sky of the half-bent arms comes to calm.

vbt-p08-v80.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 57)
vbt-p08-v80.question: What happens to fixed gaze on gross-form?
premises: Of gross-formed state fixed gaze cast down quickly.
Unsupported mind made: Śiva may go.
vbt-p08-v80.inference: Casting the fixed gaze down, the unsupported mind goes to Śiva.

vbt-p09-v81.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 58)
vbt-p09-v81.question: Where is awareness cast?
premises: On middle tongue, in opened mouth, in middle cast awareness.
H-uttering by mind: then in calm dissolves.
vbt-p09-v81.inference: The h-uttering tongue-posture drops awareness into calm.

vbt-p09-v82.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 59)
vbt-p09-v82.question: What wastes in a moment?
premises: On seat or bed unsupported, envisioning own body in mind.
When mind wasted in a moment: wasted-impurity may be.
vbt-p09-v82.inference: Envisioning own body unsupported, impurity wastes in a moment.

vbt-p09-v83.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 60)
vbt-p09-v83.question: What is won from a moving seat?
premises: On moving seat, standing slowly or body moving.
In calmed mind: O Goddess, divine flood may win.
vbt-p09-v83.inference: From the moving seat's calm, divine flood is won.

vbt-p09-v84.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 61)
vbt-p09-v84.question: What is won by unbroken gaze?
premises: Sky stainless seeing: gaze made unbroken.
Stunned self at that moment: Bhairava form may win.
vbt-p09-v84.inference: The unbroken gaze stuns the self — Bhairava-form is won at that moment.

vbt-p09-v85.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 62)
vbt-p09-v85.question: What enters when sky is all Bhairava?
premises: Dissolved on crown, sky all as Bhairava contemplated.
That all: Bhairava-form-blaze-reality may enter.
vbt-p09-v85.inference: Contemplating all-sky as Bhairava, the blaze-reality enters.

vbt-p09-v86.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 63)
vbt-p09-v86.question: What is known beyond duality?
premises: Something known: duality-giving outer light, darkness again.
Universe-Bhairava form: known, endless-light-bearing.
vbt-p09-v86.inference: Knowing Bhairava's form transmutes the duality-light into endless light.

vbt-p09-v87.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 64)
vbt-p09-v87.question: What works in the darkest night?
premises: In bad night, on dark fortnight arrival long.
Timira contemplating: Bhairava form will go to.
vbt-p09-v87.inference: Contemplating darkness itself, the Bhairava form is reached.

vbt-p09-v88.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 65)
vbt-p09-v88.question: What from closed eyes?
premises: Having closed first eyes, black lustre before.
Having spread Bhairava form contemplating: made of that may be.
vbt-p09-v88.inference: Spreading the form before closed eyes, one becomes made-of-that.

vbt-p09-v89.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 66)
vbt-p09-v89.question: What shines at the void's entry?
premises: Of whose organ even from striking and blocking.
Of entered in nondual void: there itself self shines forth.
vbt-p09-v89.inference: Enter the nondual void through any organ — there the self shines itself.

vbt-p09-v90.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 67)
vbt-p09-v90.question: What rises from the a-syllable?
premises: No drop, no emission: a-syllable of muttering great.
Rises O Goddess suddenly: knowledge-flood, highest Lord.
vbt-p09-v90.inference: The lone a-syllable suddenly rises into knowledge-flood — the Lord.

vbt-p10-v91.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 68)
vbt-p10-v91.question: How is eternal brahman touched?
premises: Of letter with emission: emission-ending awareness make.
By supportless mind: may touch brahman eternal.
vbt-p10-v91.inference: Supportless awareness on the emission-ending letter touches eternal brahman.

vbt-p10-v92.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 69)
vbt-p10-v92.question: What is meditated on?
premises: Sky-formed own self meditated, by directions uncovered.
Supportless awareness power: own form will show then.
vbt-p10-v92.inference: Meditating sky-formed self uncovered by directions, own form shows.

vbt-p10-v93.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 70)
vbt-p10-v93.question: What is pierced?
premises: Something limb pierced first with sharp needle etc.
Right there awareness yoked: in Bhairava spotless going.
vbt-p10-v93.inference: The pierced limb yokes awareness — spotless going in Bhairava.

vbt-p10-v94.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 71)
vbt-p10-v94.question: What is inside me?
premises: Mind-etc inner-making not is inside me: think thus.
By absence of fancies: fancies abandoned may be.
vbt-p10-v94.inference: Denying inner-making, fancies fall away by their absence.

vbt-p10-v95.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 72)
vbt-p10-v95.question: What is māyā?
premises: Māyā deluding: named, of part counting standing.
Counting the natures of realities: not separately may be.
vbt-p10-v95.inference: Māyā is delusion's name — counted realities never stand separately.

vbt-p10-v96.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 73)
vbt-p10-v96.question: What dissolves sudden desire?
premises: Sudden desire arisen, having seen: to calm should lead.
Where arisen, thence right there dissolves.
vbt-p10-v96.inference: Seen desire led to calm dissolves where it arose.

vbt-p10-v97.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 74)
vbt-p10-v97.question: Who am I without desire?
premises: When desire unarisen, knowing or why: then I am indeed.
Truly He-I: thus become, in that dissolved, that-minded may be.
vbt-p10-v97.inference: Unrisen desire reveals He-I — dissolved, that-minded.

vbt-p10-v98.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 75)
vbt-p10-v98.question: What is seen in desire or knowing?
premises: In desire or in knowing arisen: mind should set.
Self-mind undivided: then reality-meaning seeing.
vbt-p10-v98.inference: Setting mind undivided in either, seeing of reality's meaning follows.

vbt-p10-v99.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 76)
vbt-p10-v99.question: What is causeless knowing?
premises: Causeless may be, supportless, error-natured: truly not this of anyone.
Thus becoming Śiva, O dear.
vbt-p10-v99.inference: Knowledge not anyone's own becomes Śiva — denial turns identity.

vbt-p10-v100.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 77)
vbt-p10-v100.question: What distinguishes bodies?
premises: Consciousness-natured: in all bodies distinction not is anywhere.
Made of that all contemplating: world-conquering person.
vbt-p10-v100.inference: No bodily distinction: contemplating all made of consciousness, one conquers the world.

vbt-p11-v101.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 78)
vbt-p11-v101.question: What remains in the six-passion range?
premises: In lust-anger-greed-delusion-pride-envy range: intellect uncaused.
That reality remains.
vbt-p11-v101.inference: Uncaused within the whole passion-range, reality remains what it was.

vbt-p11-v102.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 79)
vbt-p11-v102.question: What is the world seen as?
premises: Indra-net-made world: cast or picture-work-like.
Whirling, meditating, seeing all: and joy upsurge.
vbt-p11-v102.inference: Seen as net and picture-whirl, all-seeing carries joy upsurge.

vbt-p11-v103.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 80)
vbt-p11-v103.question: Where should mind NOT be cast?
premises: Not in pain, not in joy, nor scatter around.
O Bhairavi: in middle what reality remains may be known.
vbt-p11-v103.inference: Neither pole — the middle remains, and what remains is knowable.

vbt-p11-v104.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 81)
vbt-p11-v104.question: What happiness comes from leaving body?
premises: Left own-body-standing, everywhere-I-am-thus contemplating.
Firm mind, gaze not seeing else: happy may be.
vbt-p11-v104.inference: All-pervading self-contemplation with single gaze makes happy.

vbt-p11-v105.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 82)
vbt-p11-v105.question: What is all-pervading born?
premises: In pot-etc whatever knowing, desire-etc inside me.
Never all-pervading born contemplating: thus all-going.
vbt-p11-v105.inference: Contemplating all-pervading born-within, one becomes all-going.

vbt-p11-v106.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 83)
vbt-p11-v106.question: What distinguishes yogins?
premises: Grasper-grasped awareness common of all embodied.
Of yogins but: He is, in relation carefulness.
vbt-p11-v106.inference: The yogin's distinction is attentive relation to the common awareness.

vbt-p11-v107.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 84)
vbt-p11-v107.question: What happens in another's body?
premises: Like self in other body: He even awareness should perceive.
Regard of own body left: pervasive in days may be.
vbt-p11-v107.inference: Perceiving self in other bodies, regard of one's own dissolves — pervasive.

vbt-p11-v108.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 85)
vbt-p11-v108.question: What happens to thoughts?
premises: Supportless mind made: thoughts not should think.
Then self-supreme-self in: Bhairava, O deer-eyed.
vbt-p11-v108.inference: Supportless mind cancels thinking — Bhairava stands in self-supreme-self.

vbt-p11-v109.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 86)
vbt-p11-v109.question: Who am I?
premises: All-knowing, all-doing, pervasive highest-Lord: he indeed I.
Śaiva-natured: thus from firmness Śiva may be.
vbt-p11-v109.inference: From firm conviction, 'he indeed I': Śiva-natured one becomes Śiva.

vbt-p11-v110.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 87)
vbt-p11-v110.question: How are the world-plays manifested?
premises: Like water waves, flame-plays of fire, light of sun.
Of me, of Bhairava: these world-plays manifested.
vbt-p11-v110.inference: As waves and flames and light, Bhairava's world-plays are only manifestations.

vbt-p12-v111.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 88)
vbt-p12-v111.question: What state is born when agitation ceases?
premises: Having whirled, whirled, by body swiftly from falling.
By agitation-power ceasing: supreme is born state.
vbt-p12-v111.inference: Agitation's stopping is not collapse — the supreme state is born from it.

vbt-p12-v112.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 89)
vbt-p12-v112.question: What power brings the form?
premises: On supports or by power, by knowing, from mind-dissolving.
Born power-penetration agitation-end: Bhairava form.
vbt-p12-v112.inference: Whichever of the three means ends in agitation-calm — Bhairava form is born.

vbt-p12-v113.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)
vbt-p12-v113.question: When is freedom born?
premises: Tradition this, O Goddess, hear — rightly I tell.
Even freedom is born at once, when eyes are unwinkingly fixed.
vbt-p12-v113.inference: Freedom is born at the very moment the gaze locks unwinkingly.

vbt-p12-v114.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 90)
vbt-p12-v114.question: How does one enter brahma?
premises: Contraction of ears, at lower gate likewise and.
Unsmeared, unploughed, meditating: should enter brahman eternal.
vbt-p12-v114.inference: Ear-contraction plus the lower gate, meditating unsmeared, enters eternal brahman.

vbt-p12-v115.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 91)
vbt-p12-v115.question: What dissolves from above the pit?
premises: At well or great pit, having stood above, looking.
Undivided mind rightly: at once mind-dissolving, plainly.
vbt-p12-v115.inference: Looking down from above the pit dissolves mind plainly.

vbt-p12-v116.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 92)
vbt-p12-v116.question: Where is Śiva-state where mind goes?
premises: Where mind goes — outside, inside, or even.
There Śiva-state: by pervasiveness, where will it go?
vbt-p12-v116.inference: Mind cannot exit pervasiveness — wherever it goes, Śiva-state already is.

vbt-p12-v117.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 93)
vbt-p12-v117.question: What is manifested on the eye-road?
premises: Where eye-road: consciousness manifested of the pervader.
From only-that-natured, cit-dissolving: full-self-ness.
vbt-p12-v117.inference: On every eye-road, consciousness only; dissolving in cit, full-self-ness.

vbt-p12-v118.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 94)
vbt-p12-v118.question: Which states fill with reality?
premises: At hunger-end, fear, grief, abyss, battle-fled.
At curiosity-thirst end: reality-being-full state.
vbt-p12-v118.inference: Even the passions' ends are reality-full states when met thus.

vbt-p12-v119.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 95)
vbt-p12-v119.question: Where does mind leave and the lord spread?
premises: In things remembered, seen: mind should leave in place.
Own body unsupported made: spreads forth lord.
vbt-p12-v119.inference: Leaving mind in the seen thing, the unsupported lord spreads forth.

vbt-p12-v120.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 96)
vbt-p12-v120.question: How does the gaze withdraw?
premises: Anywhere on thing placed: slowly gaze withdraw.
That knowing with mind: O Goddess, void-abode may be.
vbt-p12-v120.inference: Slow withdrawal leaves mind-knowing abiding in void.

vbt-p13-v121.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 97)
vbt-p13-v121.question: What mind arises from devotion?
premises: From devotion excess, of dispassionate: as which arises mind.
She power, Śaṅkara's — always contemplate her: then Śiva.
vbt-p13-v121.inference: The mind born of devotion IS Śaṅkara's power: contemplating her gives Śiva.

vbt-p13-v122.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 98)
vbt-p13-v122.question: What calms when voidness is meditated?
premises: In thing inside, being known, in all things voidness.
Her by mind meditated: known even becomes calm.
vbt-p13-v122.inference: Meditating voidness in all things, even known-ness becomes calm.

vbt-p13-v123.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 99)
vbt-p13-v123.question: What is the true purity?
premises: By slightly knowing which remembered purity: that in Śambhu view.
Not pure, not impure: therefore thought-free, happy may be.
vbt-p13-v123.inference: In Śambhu's view neither pure nor impure — thought-free happiness instead.

vbt-p13-v124.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 100)
vbt-p13-v124.question: Where is Bhairava-state?
premises: Everywhere Bhairava-state: in common things even, object.
Not apart from that higher: nondual going.
vbt-p13-v124.inference: Bhairava-state is immanent everywhere — nothing beyond it, nondual.

vbt-p13-v125.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 101)
vbt-p13-v125.question: How should enemy and friend stand?
premises: Same in enemy, same in friend; same in honor-dishonor.
Of brahman from fullness: thus having known, happy may be.
vbt-p13-v125.inference: Brahma's fullness known, all pairs equal — happiness follows.

vbt-p13-v126.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 102)
vbt-p13-v126.question: What glides in the middle?
premises: Not hatred anywhere, not passion somewhere.
In freedom from passion-hatred: in middle, brahman glides forth.
vbt-p13-v126.inference: Neither passion nor hatred — brahman glides forth in the middle between them.

vbt-p13-v127.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 103)
vbt-p13-v127.question: What is to be contemplated?
premises: Which unknowable, ungraspable, void, gone to nonbeing.
That all Bhairava: to be contemplated — at end, awakening arising.
vbt-p13-v127.inference: Contemplating everything as Bhairava, awakening arises at that end.

vbt-p13-v128.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 104)
vbt-p13-v128.question: Where does mind enter?
premises: In eternal, supportless, void, pervasive, calculation-free.
In outer sky mind made: into skyless should enter.
vbt-p13-v128.inference: Mind placed in outer sky enters the skyless.

vbt-p13-v129.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 105)
vbt-p13-v129.question: What becomes waveless?
premises: Where mind goes, that that by itself at that moment.
Having left non-standing: waveless then may be.
vbt-p13-v129.inference: Instant self-leaving of each place leaves mind waveless.

vbt-p13-v130.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 106)
vbt-p13-v130.question: How does Śiva come from the word?
premises: By fear all resounds; pervasive, giving all in wholeness.
Of Bhairava-word, from constant uttering: Śiva.
vbt-p13-v130.inference: Constant uttering of the Bhairava-word makes Śiva from all resounding.

vbt-p14-v131.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 107)
vbt-p14-v131.question: How does conviction free the mind?
premises: 'I, mine, this' etc: from coming to conviction.
In supportless mind goes: from that meditation impulse, calm.
vbt-p14-v131.inference: Conviction removes I-mine; supportless mind falls into calm.

vbt-p14-v132.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 108)
vbt-p14-v132.question: What is done with words?
premises: Eternal, all-pervading, supportless, pervasive, all-lord.
Words moment by moment meditating: done aim according to meaning.
vbt-p14-v132.inference: Word-meditation timed to meaning aims at the all-lord.

vbt-p14-v133.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 109)
vbt-p14-v133.question: What is reality of the net?
premises: Non-reality, indra-net-shine, this all standing.
What reality of indra-net: thus from firmness calm may go.
vbt-p14-v133.inference: From firmness through the net-question, calm goes.

vbt-p14-v134.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 110)
vbt-p14-v134.question: Where are knowing and action?
premises: Of self unwavering: where knowing, where action?
Knowing-dependent outer states: hence void, this world.
vbt-p14-v134.inference: Self needs no knowing nor action — outer world is void of both.

vbt-p14-v135.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 111)
vbt-p14-v135.question: What is bondage here?
premises: Not of me bondage, not freedom: of frightened, these terrors.
Reflection this of intellect in waters, like of sun.
vbt-p14-v135.inference: No bondage, no freedom — terrors are mere reflections, sun-in-water.

vbt-p14-v136.speaker: Bhairava (dhāraṇā 112-ish close-block)
vbt-p14-v136.question: What happens to the senses?
premises: Sense-doored all: pleasure-pain-etc meeting, senses left.
Self-abiding in own self abides.
vbt-p14-v136.inference: Leaving the sense-doored meetings, one abides self-abiding in own self.
uncertainties: closing-block; sūtra count varies by recension

vbt-p14-v137.speaker: Bhairava (closing block)
vbt-p14-v137.question: How is everything lit?
premises: Knowing-lighting all: by all self lighting.
One, from one-nature-ness: knowing knowable is envisioned.
vbt-p14-v137.inference: From one-nature, one self lights all — knowing and knowable are one vision.

vbt-p14-v138.speaker: Bhairava (closing block)
vbt-p14-v138.question: What fourfold must be wasted?
premises: Mental, consciousness, power, self, and mind: fourfold.
When, O dear, fully wasted: then that Bhairava form.

vbt-p14-v139.speaker: Bhairava (counting)
vbt-p14-v139.question: How many teachings were told?
premises: Of waveless teachings hundred told in brief; twelve-plus.
O Goddess, which having known: knowing-knower person.
vbt-p14-v139.inference: The hundred-plus-twelve count delivered in brief — a knower knows them.
uncertainties: 100+12 count noted — recension-dependent (cf. 112 in other recensions)

vbt-p14-v140.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)
vbt-p14-v140.question: What happens in one's own yoking?
premises: Here and in one yoked: becomes Bhairava himself.
By speech does deeds: curse-favor making.
vbt-p14-v140.inference: Self-yoked, one IS Bhairava — his speech becomes curser-and-favorer.

vbt-p15-v141.speaker: Bhairava (closing block)
vbt-p15-v141.question: Who attains agelessness?
premises: Ageless deathlessness attains he, atom-qualities endowed.
Of yoginīs dear, O Goddess: all-gathering lord.
vbt-p15-v141.inference: Endowed with atomic qualities, he gathers all — yoginīs' dear lord.

vbt-p15-v142.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)
vbt-p15-v142.question: Is the freed one smeared while acting?
premises: Living even, freed; doing even, not smeared.
This body if of supreme and great lord, O god.
vbt-p15-v142.inference: Freed while living, acting unsmeared — supreme body of the great lord.

vbt-p15-v143.speaker: Bhairava (rhetorical)
vbt-p15-v143.question: Who mutes, meditates, worships?
premises: In thus-told state: who mutters, who meditates, who worships, who pleased?
vbt-p15-v143.inference: The rhetorical four: in this state, who at all mutes and worships?
uncertainties: rhetorical negatives — v144 supplies the outer-rite answer

vbt-p15-v144.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p15-v144.question: Who is offered oblation?
premises: Who offered oblation or sacrifice, and what how?
This procedure outer, in gross things: O deer-eyed.
vbt-p15-v144.inference: These are outer procedures in gross things — the inner already answered.

vbt-p15-v145.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p15-v145.question: What is the real japa?
premises: Again in supreme state: contemplation contemplated which.
Muttering there: self-sound, mantra-natured — such the japya.
vbt-p15-v145.inference: In supreme state, japa is self-sound mantra-natured, not recited formula.
uncertainties: 'tra kept; svayaṃ nādo = the sound itself

vbt-p15-v146.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p15-v146.question: What is meditation?
premises: Meditation: unmoving intellect, formless, supportless.
Not meditation: body-eye-mouth-hand-etc imagining.
vbt-p15-v146.inference: Meditation is motionless formless intellect — not bodily imagery.

vbt-p15-v147.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p15-v147.question: What is worship?
premises: Worship named: not flowers — mind made firm.
In undifferentiated great sky: that worship, from care, dissolving.
vbt-p15-v147.inference: True worship is firm mind dissolving in the undifferentiated sky.

vbt-p15-v148.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p15-v148.question: What arises from practice?
premises: Here in one-yoking standing: when from day to day.
Full-formed state: right here, contentment, utter fullness.
vbt-p15-v148.inference: Day by day in the one-yoking, full-formed state ripens to utter fullness.

vbt-p15-v149.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p15-v149.question: What is offered in the great void?
premises: In great void abode, in fire: sense-objects etc.
By mind, with all oblation, with awareness ladle.
vbt-p15-v149.inference: In the void-fire, mind offers all with the awareness-ladle.

vbt-p15-v150.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p15-v150.question: What is the sacrifice?
premises: Sacrifice here, O highest lady: contentment, bliss-marked.
From wasting all sins, from protecting all, O mountain-daughter.
vbt-p15-v150.inference: Sacrifice is contentment itself — it wastes sins and protects all.

vbt-p16-v151.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p16-v151.question: What is worship if not penetration?
premises: Rudra-power-penetration: that field, contemplation supreme.
Otherwise: of reality what worship, what pleased?
vbt-p16-v151.inference: Without penetration into that field, no worship pleases anything.

vbt-p16-v152.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p16-v152.question: What is the entering-bath?
premises: Free-bliss-consciousness-mere essence: own self everywhere.
Entering in that form: of own self bath declared.
vbt-p16-v152.inference: Entering one's own form IS the bath — free-bliss-consciousness everywhere.

vbt-p16-v153.speaker: Bhairava (rhetorical)
vbt-p16-v153.question: Who and what are worshipped?
premises: By which is worshipped, with materials pleased.
Who and where worshipper: all he, very one, where?
vbt-p16-v153.inference: Worshipper and worshipped collapse to one — where is the second?

vbt-p16-v154.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p16-v154.question: How does breath enter life?
premises: Breath may go, life may enter, by will crooked-formed.
Long-formed she, great goddess: other field, higher-lower.
vbt-p16-v154.inference: By will, the crooked-formed breath enters life — the goddess' other field.

vbt-p16-v155.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p16-v155.question: What is attained along the path?
premises: In this walking-along, standing in great-bliss-made path.
By her entered: supreme Bhairava may attain.
vbt-p16-v155.inference: Entered by her on the bliss-path, supreme Bhairava is attained.

vbt-p16-v156.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p16-v156.question: How much japa?
premises: Six hundreds by day, by night thousand twenty-one.
Of goddess declared: easy, hard by dullards.
vbt-p16-v156.inference: The goddess' japa count: 66000/day given as hard for the dull.

vbt-p16-v157.speaker: Bhairava (secrecy)
vbt-p16-v157.question: Who may hear this?
premises: Thus this told, O Goddess: supreme nectar highest.
Never to be shown of anyone, but ever.
vbt-p16-v157.inference: Supreme nectar — told, yet never to be shown to just anyone, ever.

vbt-p16-v158.speaker: Bhairava (secrecy)
vbt-p16-v158.question: To whom NOT to give?
premises: To another pupil, base, cruel, non-devoted: of guru feet.
But of thought-free-minded, heroes, lofty-souled.
vbt-p16-v158.inference: Withheld from the unworthy, given to thought-free heroes only.

vbt-p16-v159.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p16-v159.question: What may be given to the devoted?
premises: Of devoted, of guru-group: given without hesitation.
Village, kingdom, town, country, son-wife-family.
vbt-p16-v159.inference: Everything — kingdom and family — may be given to the guru's devoted without hesitation.

vbt-p16-v160.speaker: Bhairava (teaching)
vbt-p16-v160.question: What is the steady wealth?
premises: All this left: to-be-grasped this, O deer-eyed.
What with these unsteady: steady supreme this wealth; lives given, nectar not-to-be-given.
vbt-p16-v160.inference: Unsteady things left, the un-given nectar is the steady wealth.

vbt-p17-v161.speaker: Devī (satisfied)
vbt-p17-v161.question: What does Devī say now?
premises: God of gods, great god: fully content am I.
Of Rudrayāmala tantra: essence today held.
vbt-p17-v161.inference: Devī declared content — the tantra's essence is held today; union begins.
uncertainties: v161: Devī's satisfaction — union seal starts

vbt-p17-v162.speaker: Colophon (closing)
vbt-p17-v162.question: How does the work close?
premises: Of all power-divisions: heart known today.
Thus spoken delighted: goddess on neck clung, of Śiva.
vbt-p17-v162.inference: Heart known and spoken, the delighted goddess clasps Śiva's neck — the seal.
uncertainties: closing seal: kaṇṭhe lagnā — union, no verse follows

vbt-p01-v01.plain_english: I have heard it all, O Lord — how it is born of Rudrayāmala, how the Trika divisions run, distinguished out of essence, essence by essence.
vbt-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: śrutaṃ deva mayā sarvaṃ rudrayāmalasambhavam | trikabhedam aśeṣeṇa sārāt sāravibhāgaśaḥ

vbt-p01-v02.plain_english: Even now the doubt is not dispelled in me, O highest Lord: what form is it in truth, O god — made of the heap of words and digits?
vbt-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: adyāpi na nivṛtto me saṃśayaḥ parameśvara | kiṃ rūpaṃ tattvato deva śabdarāśikalāmayam

vbt-p01-v03.plain_english: Is it the ninefold self, divided — Bhairava, Bhairava's form; split by the three-headed division, or, what, the nature of the three powers?
vbt-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ vā navātmabhedena bhairave bhairavākṛtau | triśirobhedabhinnaṃ vā kiṃ vā śaktitrayātmakam

vbt-p01-v04.plain_english: Or made of nāda's drop? Or the checkers of the moon's half? Mounted on the wheel, unsmeared? Or what, the power-formed?
vbt-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: nādabindumayaṃ vāpi kiṃ candrārdhanirodhikāḥ | cakrārūḍham anackaṃ vā kiṃ vā śaktisvarūpakam

vbt-p01-v05.plain_english: Of higher and lower, the whole — and of the lower, or again: but if the higher be that way, its higher-ness is contradicted.
vbt-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: parāparāyāḥ sakalam aparāyāś ca vā punaḥ | parāyā yadi tadvat syāt paratvaṃ tad virudhyate

vbt-p01-v06.plain_english: For it cannot come about by letter-division, or by dividing bodies: higher-ness is partlessness — not that, in wholeness.
vbt-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: na hi varṇavibhedena dehabhedena vā bhavet | paratvaṃ niṣkalatvena sakalatve na tad bhavet

vbt-p01-v07.plain_english: Grant me grace, O Lord — cut the doubt entirely: good, good, what you have asked — this, the essence of the tantra, O dear.
vbt-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: prasādaṃ kuru me nātha niḥśeṣaṃ chinddhi saṃśayam | sādhu sādhu tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ tantrasāram idam priye

vbt-p01-v08.plain_english: Most worthy of hiding, O fortunate one — yet I will tell you whatever whole form of Bhairava is proclaimed.
vbt-p01-v08.sanskrit_cite: gūhanīyatamam bhadre tathāpi kathayāmi te | yatkiṃcit sakalaṃ rūpaṃ bhairavasya prakīrtitam

vbt-p01-v09.plain_english: That must be known by its unsubstantialness, O Goddess — like Indra's net; like a māyā-dream, and indeed, the error of Gandharva cities.
vbt-p01-v09.sanskrit_cite: tad asāratayā devi vijñeyaṃ śakrajālavat | māyāsvapnopamaṃ caiva gandharvanagarabhramam

vbt-p01-v10.plain_english: For meditation's sake — for confused minds, for dwellers in pompous rite — it is described merely, for men whose selves are struck by fancy.
vbt-p01-v10.sanskrit_cite: dhyānārtham bhrāntabuddhīnāṃ kriyāḍambaravartinām | kevalaṃ varṇitam puṃsāṃ vikalpanihatātmanām

vbt-p02-v11.plain_english: In truth it is not that ninefold self, not the heap of words, not Bhairava; not that three-headed god either, nor the nature of the three powers.
vbt-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: tattvato na navātmāsau śabdarāśir na bhairavaḥ | na cāsau triśirā devo na ca śaktitrayātmakaḥ

vbt-p02-v12.plain_english: Not made of nāda's drop, either; not the checkers of the moon; not joined to the wheel's course, not the power-formed.
vbt-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: nādabindumayo vāpi na candrārdhanirodhikāḥ | na cakrakramasambhinno na ca śaktisvarūpakaḥ

vbt-p02-v13.plain_english: These terrors of unawakened minds are strong indeed; like a mother's sweet, all of it is declared for the sake of going on.
vbt-p02-v13.sanskrit_cite: aprabuddhamatīnāṃ hi etā balavibhīṣikāḥ | mātṛmodakavat sarvaṃ pravṛttyarthaṃ udāhṛtam

vbt-p02-v14.plain_english: Free of direction, time and counting — with no particular place or point: it cannot be pointed out; untellable in the end.
vbt-p02-v14.sanskrit_cite: dikkālakalanonmuktā deśoddeśāviśeṣinī | vyapadeṣṭum aśakyāsāv akathyā paramārthataḥ

vbt-p02-v15.plain_english: Joy of inner self-taste, unhoused in fancy's range — that full-formed state, Bhairavī, of Bhairava's own self.
vbt-p02-v15.sanskrit_cite: antaḥsvānubhavānandā vikalponmuktagocarā | yāvasthā bharitākārā bhairavī bhairavātmanaḥ

vbt-p02-v16.plain_english: That body must be known in truth: stainless, filling the world — in such a supreme reality, who is worshipped, and which one is pleased?
vbt-p02-v16.sanskrit_cite: tad vapus tattvato jñeyaṃ vimalaṃ viśvapūraṇam | evaṃvidhe pare tattve kaḥ pūjyaḥ kaś ca tṛpyati

vbt-p02-v17.plain_english: Whatever state of Bhairava's is sung like this: she is the supreme one — proclaimed the supreme goddess as the supreme form.
vbt-p02-v17.sanskrit_cite: evaṃvidhā bhairavasya yāvasthā parigīyate | sā parā pararūpeṇa parā devī prakīrtitā

vbt-p02-v18.plain_english: As the non-difference of power and the powerful stands always — hence, from that property-owning, the supreme power of the supreme self.
vbt-p02-v18.sanskrit_cite: śaktiśaktimator yadvad abhedaḥ sarvadā sthitaḥ | atas taddharmadharmitvāt parā śaktiḥ parātmanaḥ

vbt-p02-v19.plain_english: No power separate from fire's burning is conceived; only in knowing-being, in entering, does this beginning arise.
vbt-p02-v19.sanskrit_cite: na vahner dāhikā śaktir vyatiriktā vibhāvyate | kevalaṃ jñānasattāyām prārambho 'yam praveśane

vbt-p02-v20.plain_english: Of one entered into the power-state, contemplation without division — then he becomes Śiva-formed: that mouth is called Śaivī.
vbt-p02-v20.sanskrit_cite: śaktyavasthāpraviṣṭasya nirvibhāgena bhāvanā | tadāsau śivarūpī syāt śaivī mukham ihocyate

vbt-p03-v21.plain_english: Just as by the world-light of a lamp, by rays, and of the sun, direction and division and the rest are known — so by power, Śiva is known, O dear.
vbt-p03-v21.sanskrit_cite: yathālokena dīpasya kiraṇair bhāskarasya ca | jñāyate digvibhāgādi tadvac chaktyā śivaḥ priye

vbt-p03-v22.plain_english: God of gods, marked with the trident, adorned with the skull: void of direction, place and time — and free of designation.
vbt-p03-v22.sanskrit_cite: devadeva triśūlāṅka kapālakṛtabhūṣaṇa | digdeśakālaśūnyā ca vyapadeśavivarjitā

vbt-p03-v23.plain_english: What is that full-formed state of Bhairava, and by what means does its door open, O supreme Goddess? Tell me as you rightly know it, Bhairava.
vbt-p03-v23.sanskrit_cite: yāvasthā bharitākārā bhairavasyopalabhyate | kair upāyair mukhaṃ tasya parā devi katham bhavet | yathā samyag ahaṃ vedmi tathā me brūhi bhairava

vbt-p03-v24.plain_english: Breath above, life below, and the emission-natured one should utter forth: at the two arising places, filled from filling, standing.
vbt-p03-v24.sanskrit_cite: ūrdhve prāṇo hy adho jīvo visargātmā paroccaret | utpattidvitayasthāne bharaṇād bharitā sthitiḥ

vbt-p03-v25.plain_english: Of wind within or without, or even from the sky-pair not turning; by Bhairavī — of Bhairava thus, O Bhairavī, the manifested form.
