sections.RELATED: cf. VBT's own frame (inner vs outer procedures named in v144); contentment-sacrifice echoes Parātriṃśikā p04 p023-style self-offering (parallel, not source).

essence: Without penetration-field, what worship pleases?
Own-self everywhere: entering that form is one's bath.
Worshipper and worshipped collapse: where the second?
Breath, life, will: crooked-formed, she the other field.
Bliss-path walking: entered by her, Bhairava attained.
Six-six-thousand a day, thousand twenty-one by night: hard for dull.
Supreme nectar told — never to be shown to anyone.
Withheld from base, cruel, non-devoted; to heroes given.
Everything given to devotees without hesitation.
Unsteady all dropped: the un-given nectar is steady wealth.

rasa.justification: Questions accumulate (who worships whom) and collapse into one; then the secrecy injunction lands as the text's heaviest verse — gravity without agitation, a hush rather than a shout.

sections.SUMMARY: The worship-and-secrecy block: without penetration into that field, no worship pleases anything; own-self entering own form IS the bath; worshipper and worshipped reduce to one — where the second; breath, life and will crooked-formed under goddess' other field; the bliss-path walked entered-by-her giving Bhairava; the japa count (six-six-thousand a day, thousand twenty-one by night) hard for the dull; then the hush — supreme nectar, told, never to be shown to anyone; withheld from the base and cruel, given to thought-free heroes; everything else — village, kingdom, family — given to devotees without hesitation; and the last reversal: unsteady things dropped, the un-given nectar is the steady supreme wealth.
sections.FUNCTION: Closes the teaching with the text's strongest boundary: the told nectar that cannot be shown, and what may be given instead.
sections.KEY TERMS: snāna (own-form as bath); mukti as havi (already-fruit as offering); japa-saṅkhyā (66000/12000 counts); prakāśya (showable — the prohibited); dātavya (given — the permitted).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The count-verse and secrecy prepare Devī's satisfaction and the union-seal (p17).
sections.BOUNDARY: v157 is THE boundary verse — 'never shown to anyone, ever'; all downstream dissemination must respect it (our own quotes stay minimal by house rules anyway).
sections.EXPLANATION: Worship is relativized twice: penetration is what makes it real, and the worshipper-worshipped pair collapses to one, so ritual question loses its second term. The practice then continues anyway — will-breath entering the goddess' other field, bliss-path attainment, and the famous japa count given as difficulty for the dull rather than achievement for the virtuous. Then the hinge: this told nectar is never showable — the only verses of refusal in the text — with the equally famous inversion that everything worldly (village, kingdom, family) may be given freely to the devoted, while the nectar itself is never given, because it is the unsteady all dropped for the steady wealth.
sections.RELATED: Singh on secrecy passage; Hareesh closing-verses project (vv140+ analysis); count variants (recension-sensitive, flagged).

essence: Devī: fully content — the tantra's essence held today.
Heart of all power-divisions known: goddess clasps Śiva's neck.

rasa.justification: Two verses: declared contentment, then the physical seal — mouth to neck, no more teaching. Wonder at the doctrine resolves into embrace; the rasa is joy that stops talking.

sections.SUMMARY: Devī declares full contentment: the essence of the Rudrayāmala-tantra held today. And the heart of all power-divisions is known today as well: having spoken, delighted, the goddess clasps Śiva's neck — the text ends where the dialogue began, in union, with nothing further said.
sections.FUNCTION: Seals the dialogue: contentment declared, union enacted in the last image, the count closed.
sections.KEY TERMS: tṛpti (contentment as completion); hṛdaya (heart as what is known); kaṇṭha-lagna (neck-clasping — the union image); rudrayāmala (the named tantra frame).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Pays off the frame: the doubt-vines of p01 end in embrace; the secrecy of p16 ends in what IS given — herself.
sections.BOUNDARY: No verse follows; the colophon is the boundary itself.
sections.EXPLANATION: The two closing acts: first the verbal seal (content, essence held — the teaching has an owner now), then the somatic seal (heart known, goddess delighted, mouth on neck). Everything the 160 verses asked dissolves into a body-position: question and answer, nectar and secrecy, ends clasped. The tantra names itself (Rudrayāmala) in the same breath as its knowledge is declared complete — held, and in the holding, done.
sections.RELATED: Hareesh closing-verses analysis (23-verse frame); union-image returns the frame's 'arisen from our union' reading (lore).

lines: Heard by me, all — Rudrayāmala-born:
the Trika's divisions, essence by essence run.

lines: Even now the doubt is not dispelled in me —
what form is it in truth, made of word-heap and digit?
vbt-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: adyāpi na nivṛtto me saṃśayaḥ parameśvara | kiṃ rūpaṃ tattvato deva śabdarāśikalāmayam

lines: Nine-self division? Bhairava in his form?
three-head split? power-triad? which is it?
vbt-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ vā navātmabhedena bhairave bhairavākṛtau | triśirobhedabhinnaṃ vā kiṃ vā śaktitrayātmakam

lines: Nāda's drop, the moon-crescent's checks —
or wheel-mounted, unsmeared: power-formed, what?

if higher then were that, its higher-ness contradicts.

higher-ness is partlessness — that, not, in wholeness.
vbt-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: na hi varṇavibhedena dehabhedena vā bhavet | paratvaṃ niṣkalatvena sakalatve na tad bhavet

lines: Grant grace, O Lord — cut the doubt entire:
what you were asked, is the tantra's very essence.
vbt-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: prasādaṃ kuru me nātha niḥśeṣaṃ chinddhi saṃśayam | sādhu sādhu tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ tantrasāram idam priye

lines: Most worthy of hiding, fortunate one —
yet will I tell you: all Bhairava's form, proclaimed.
vbt-p01-v08.sanskrit_cite: gūhanīyatamam bhadre tathāpi kathayāmi te | yatkiṃcit sakalaṃ rūpaṃ bhairavasya prakīrtitam

lines: Known by its own unsubstantialness, Goddess —
Indra-net, māyā's dream, the Gandharva-city's error.
vbt-p01-v09.sanskrit_cite: tad asāratayā devi vijñeyaṃ śakrajālavat | māyāsvapnopamaṃ caiva gandharvanagarabhramam

dwellers: described merely, fancy-struck men.
vbt-p01-v10.sanskrit_cite: dhyānārtham bhrāntabuddhīnāṃ kriyāḍambaravartinām | kevalaṃ varṇitam puṃsāṃ vikalpanihatātmanām

lines: Not nine-self, not word-heap, not Bhairava —
not three-headed god, not power-triad's nature.
vbt-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: tattvato na navātmāsau śabdarāśir na bhairavaḥ | na cāsau triśirā devo na ca śaktitrayātmakaḥ

lines: Not nāda-drop, not moon's checks, not wheel-joined —
not power-formed.
vbt-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: nādabindumayo vāpi na candrārdhanirodhikāḥ | na cakrakramasambhinno na ca śaktisvarūpakaḥ

vbt-p02-v14.sanskrit_cite: dikkālakalanonmuktā deśoddeśāviśeṣinī | vyapadeṣṭum aśakyāsāv akathyā paramārthataḥ

that full-formed state — Bhairavī of Bhairava's self.
vbt-p02-v15.sanskrit_cite: antaḥsvānubhavānandā vikalponmuktagocarā | yāvasthā bharitākārā bhairavī bhairavātmanaḥ

lines: That body must be known in truth — stainless,
world-filling: who worships, which pleased, in such reality?

lines: Treeless mountain, wall, such place: gaze cast well;
mind dissolved in state — the wasting of turning is born.
vbt-p06-v60.sanskrit_cite: nirvṛkṣagiribhittyādideśe dṛṣṭiṃ vinikṣipet | vilīne mānase bhāve vṛttikṣiṇaḥ prajāyate

lines: Both states, knowing meditated — the middle resort to:
at once, both left — in middle reality shines forth.
vbt-p07-v61.sanskrit_cite: ubhayor bhāvayor jñāne dhyātvā madhyaṃ samāśrayet | yugapac ca dvayaṃ tyaktvā madhye tattvam prakāśate

lines: State abandoned, restrained consciousness goes no-where-else:
then in that middle-being — contemplation expands exceedingly.
vbt-p07-v62.sanskrit_cite: bhāve tyakte niruddhā cin naiva bhāvāntaraṃ vrajet | tadā tanmadhyabhāvena vikasatyati bhāvanā

lines: All body consciousness-made, or world, fancy fully:
at once by undivided mind — supreme rise.
vbt-p07-v63.sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ dehaṃ cinmayaṃ hi jagad vā paribhāvayet | yugapan nirvikalpena manasā paramodayaḥ

lines: Two winds, clashing, inside or outside at limit:
yogin — of evenness-knowing's rise, the offering-vessel.
vbt-p07-v64.sanskrit_cite: vāyudvayasya saṃghaṭṭād antar vā bahir antataḥ | yogī samatvavijñānasamudgamanabhājanam

lines: All world or own body, with own bliss filled, remember:
at once with own nectar — full of supreme bliss may be.
vbt-p07-v65.sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ jagat svadehaṃ vā svānandabharitaṃ smaret | yugapat svāmṛtenaiva parānandamayo bhavet

lines: By trick, by application, at once, deer-eyed:
great bliss manifests — by which reality shines.
vbt-p07-v66.sanskrit_cite: kuhanena prayogeṇa sadya eva mṛgekṣaṇe | samudeti mahānando yena tattvaṃ prakāśate

lines: Channels all bound, up-breath power, slowly:
at the crawling ant's time — supreme happiness spreads.
vbt-p07-v67.sanskrit_cite: sarvasrotonibandhena prāṇaśaktyordhvayā śanaiḥ | pipīlasparśavelāyām prathate paramaṃ sukham

lines: Fire and poison, middle: mind happiness-made cast —
mere wind-filled, or yoked by remembrance-bliss.
vbt-p07-v68.sanskrit_cite: vahner viṣasya madhye tu cittaṃ sukhamayaṃ kṣipet | kevalaṃ vāyupūrṇaṃ vā smarānandena yujyate

lines: Agitated by union, shaking, power-penetration's end:
whatever brahman-reality's happiness — self-told, that told.
vbt-p07-v69.sanskrit_cite: śaktisaṃgamasaṃkṣubdhaśaktyāveśāvasānikam | yat sukham brahmatattvasya tat sukhaṃ svākyam ucyate

lines: Licking, churning, pounding's apex — woman-bliss from
fullness, from memory: power-absent, bliss-flood may be.
vbt-p07-v70.sanskrit_cite: lehanāmanthanākoṭaiḥ strīsukhasya bharāt smṛteḥ | śaktyabhāve 'pi deveśi bhaved ānandasamplavaḥ

lines: In joy, great, won — seen or kinsman long after:
bliss risen, meditated — dissolved in that, of that mind may be.
vbt-p08-v71.sanskrit_cite: ānande mahati prāpte dṛṣṭe vā bāndhave cirāt | ānandam udgataṃ dhyātvā tallayas tanmanā bhavet

lines: Eating, drinking, joy's swelling, bliss-blooming:
fancy the filled state — great bliss then may be.
vbt-p08-v72.sanskrit_cite: jagdhipānakṛtollāsarasānandavijṛmbhaṇāt | bhāvayed bharitāvasthāṃ mahānandas tato bhavet

lines: Objects-tasting such as song — happiness unshared,
one-selfness: absorbedness mounted — that selfness.
Where mind content — there right the mind should hold:
there, there — supreme-bliss-own-form proceeds forth.
vbt-p08-v74.sanskrit_cite: yatra yatra manas tuṣṭir manas tatraiva dhārayet | tatra tatra parānandasvārūpaṃ sampravartate

lines: In not-yet-come, in sleep, outer range perished:
that state to be gone by mind — supreme Goddess shines.
vbt-p08-v75.sanskrit_cite: anāgatāyāṃ nidrāyām praṇaṣṭe bāhyagocare | sāvasthā manasā gamyā parā devī prakāśate

lines: Sun, lamp brilliance, dappled sky:
gaze fixed right there — own self-form shines.
vbt-p08-v76.sanskrit_cite: tejasā sūryadīpāder ākāśe śabalīkṛte | dṛṣṭir niveśyā tatraiva svātmarūpam prakāśate

lines: By skeleton, angry, licking Bhairavī, sky-going:
at gaze's time — supreme attainment shines.
vbt-p08-v77.sanskrit_cite: karaṅkiṇyā krodhanayā bhairavyā lelihānayā | khecaryā dṛṣṭikāle ca parāvāptiḥ prakāśate

lines: Soft seat, one buttock, hands feet unsupported:
by that context — supreme full mind may be.
vbt-p08-v78.sanskrit_cite: mṛdvāsane sphijaikena hastapādau nirāśrayam | nidhāya tatprasaṅgena parā pūrṇā matir bhavet

lines: Seated rightly, arms two half-bent:
armpit-sky mind-making — calm comes by dissolving.
vbt-p08-v79.sanskrit_cite: upaviśyāsane samyag bāhū kṛtvārdhakuñcitau | kakṣavyomni manaḥ kurvan śamam āyāti tallayāt

lines: Gross-formed state's fixed gaze cast down quickly:
unsupported mind made — Śiva one may go to.
vbt-p08-v80.sanskrit_cite: sthūlarūpasya bhāvasya stabdhāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ nipātya ca | acireṇa nirādhāraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā śivaṃ vrajet

lines: Mid-tongue awareness cast, opened mouth:
h-utterance made by mind — in calm dissolves.
vbt-p09-v81.sanskrit_cite: madhyajihve sphāritāsye madhye nikṣipya cetanām | hoccāraṃ manasā kurvaṃs tataḥ śānte pralīyate

lines: Seat, bed, standing, unsupported, own-body vision:
mind wasted — in a moment impurity wastes away.
vbt-p09-v82.sanskrit_cite: āsane śayane sthitvā nirādhāraṃ vibhāvayan | svadehaṃ manasi kṣiṇe kṣaṇāt kṣīṇāśayo bhavet

lines: Moving seat, standing still or body moving:
calmed mind, in that state — Goddess, divine flood won.
vbt-p09-v83.sanskrit_cite: calāsane sthitasyātha śanair vā dehacālanāt | praśānte mānase bhāve devi divyaugham āpnuyāt

lines: Sky stainless, seeing: gaze unbroken made:
stunned self, that moment — Bhairava form won.
vbt-p09-v84.sanskrit_cite: ākāśaṃ vimalam paśyan kṛtvā dṛṣṭiṃ nirantarām | stabdhātmā tatkṣaṇād devi bhairavaṃ vapur āpnuyāt

lines: Crown dissolved, sky all as Bhairava:
that all — Bhairava-form-blaze-reality enters.
vbt-p09-v85.sanskrit_cite: līnaṃ mūrdhni viyat sarvam bhairavatvena bhāvayet | tat sarvam bhairavākāratejastattvaṃ samāviśet

lines: Something known, duality-light, darkness again:
Bhairava's universe-form — endless-light-bearing known.
vbt-p09-v86.sanskrit_cite: kiñcij jñātaṃ dvaitadāyi bāhyālokas tamaḥ punaḥ | viśvādi bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ jñātvānantaprakāśabhṛt

lines: Bad night, dark fortnight, long in it:
contemplating timira — Bhairava's form will come.
vbt-p09-v87.sanskrit_cite: evam eva durniśāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣāgame ciram | taimiram bhāvayan rūpam bhairavaṃ rūpam eṣyati

lines: Eyes closed first, black lustre before:
Bhairava's form spread — made-of-that may be.
vbt-p09-v88.sanskrit_cite: evam eva nimīlyādau netre kṛṣṇābham agrataḥ | prasārya bhairavaṃ rūpam bhāvayaṃs tanmayo bhavet

lines: Whichever organ's striking and blocking:
entered nondual void — there itself, self shines.
vbt-p09-v89.sanskrit_cite: yasya kasyendriyasyāpi vyāghātāc ca nirodhataḥ | praviṣṭasyādvaye śūnye tatraivātmā prakāśate

lines: No drop, no emission: lone a-syllable great:
rises, Goddess, sudden — knowledge-flood, highest Lord.
vbt-p09-v90.sanskrit_cite: abindum avisargaṃ ca akāraṃ japato mahān | udeti devi sahasā jñānaughaḥ parameśvaraḥ

lines: Letter with emission, emission-ending awareness:
by supportless mind — eternal brahman touched.
vbt-p10-v91.sanskrit_cite: varṇasya savisargasya visargāntaṃ citiṃ kuru | nirādhāreṇa cittena spṛśed brahma sanātanam

lines: Sky-formed own self meditated, directions uncovered:
supportless awareness-power — own form shows then.
vbt-p10-v92.sanskrit_cite: vyomākāraṃ svam ātmānaṃ dhyāyed digbhir anāvṛtam | nirāśrayā citiḥ śaktiḥ svarūpaṃ darśayet tadā

lines: Some limb pierced first, needle-etc:
right there awareness yoked — spotless going in Bhairava.
vbt-p10-v93.sanskrit_cite: kiṃcid aṅgaṃ vibhidyādau tīkṣṇasūcyādinā tataḥ | tatraiva cetanāṃ yuktvā bhairave nirmalā gatiḥ

lines: Inner-making not inside me — think thus:
fancies absent, abandoned may be.
vbt-p10-v94.sanskrit_cite: cittādyantaḥkṛtir nāsti mamāntar bhāvayed iti | vikalpānām abhāvena vikalpair ujjhito bhavet

lines: Māyā deluding, named — part-counting standing:
counting realities' such-natures — not separately may be.
vbt-p10-v95.sanskrit_cite: māyā vimohinī nāma kalāyāḥ kalanaṃ sthitam | ityādidharmaṃ tattvānāṃ kalayan na pṛthag bhavet

lines: Sudden desire arisen, seen — lead to calm:
where it arose, there right there dissolves.
vbt-p10-v96.sanskrit_cite: jhagitīcchāṃ samutpannām avalokya śamaṃ nayet | yata eva samudbhūtā tatas tatraiva līyate

lines: When my desire unarisen, knowing, or why —
then I am: truly He-I, dissolved, that-minded.
vbt-p10-v97.sanskrit_cite: yadā mamecchā notpannā jñānaṃ vā kas tadāsmi vai | tattvato =B9haṃ tathābhūtas tallīnas tanmanā bhavet

lines: In desire or knowing, when arisen, mind set:
self-mind undivided — then reality-meaning seen.
vbt-p10-v98.sanskrit_cite: icchāyām athavā jñāne jāte cittaṃ niveśayet | ātmabuddhyānanyacetās tatas tattvārthadarśanam

lines: Causeless may knowing be, supportless, error-natured:
anyone's not this — thus becoming Śiva, O dear.
vbt-p10-v99.sanskrit_cite: nirnimittam bhavej jñānaṃ nirādhāram bhramātmakam | tattvataḥ kasyacin naitad evambhāvī śivaḥ priye

lines: Consciousness-natured, all bodies, no distinction:
made of that, contemplating all — world-conqueror.
vbt-p10-v100.sanskrit_cite: ciddharmā sarvadeheṣu viśeṣo nāsti kutracit | ataś ca tanmayaṃ sarvam bhāvayan bhavajij janaḥ

lines: Passion-range — lust, anger, greed, delusion, pride, envy:
uncaused intellect made there — reality remains.
vbt-p11-v101.sanskrit_cite: kāmakrodhalobhamohamadamātsaryagocare | buddhiṃ nistimitāṃ kṛtvā tat tattvam avaśiṣyate

lines: Indra-net world, cast, or picture-work-like, whirling:
meditating all, seeing all — joy upsurges.
vbt-p11-v102.sanskrit_cite: indrajālamayaṃ viśvaṃ vyastaṃ vā citrakarmavat | bhramad vā dhyāyataḥ sarvam paśyataś ca sukhodgamaḥ

lines: Not mind cast in pain, not joy, scattered nowhere:
Bhairavī — in middle what remains may be known.
vbt-p11-v103.sanskrit_cite: na cittaṃ nikṣiped duḥkhe na sukhe vā parikṣipet | bhairavi jñāyatāṃ madhye kiṃ tattvam avaśiṣyate

lines: Own-body-standing left, everywhere-I-am-thus:
firm mind, gaze seeing none else — happy may be.
vbt-p11-v104.sanskrit_cite: vihāya nijadehasthaṃ sarvatrāsmīti bhāvayan | dṛḍhena manasā dṛṣṭyā nānyekṣiṇyā sukhī bhavet

lines: Pot and such, knowing, desire and such, inside me:
never all-pervading born — all-going contemplating thus.
vbt-p11-v105.sanskrit_cite: ghaṭādau yac ca vijñānam icchādyaṃ vā mamāntare | naiva sarvagataṃ jātam bhāvayan iti sarvagaḥ

lines: Grasped-grasping awareness: all embodied common;
yogins' distinction: He-is — relation, carefulness.
vbt-p11-v106.sanskrit_cite: grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittiḥ sāmānyā sarvadehinām | yogināṃ tu viśeṣo =B9sti sambandhe sāvadhānatā

lines: Like self in other's body — He perceives awareness:
own-body-regard left — pervasive in days may be.
vbt-p11-v107.sanskrit_cite: svavad anyaśarīre =B9pi saṃvittim anubhāvayet | apekṣāṃ svaśarīrasya tyaktvā vyāpī dinair bhavet

lines: Supportless mind made — thoughts not to be thought:
in self-supreme-self — Bhairava, deer-eyed.
vbt-p11-v108.sanskrit_cite: nirādhāraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā vikalpān na vikalpayet | tadātmaparamātmatve bhairavo mṛgalocane

lines: All-knowing, all-doing, pervasive highest-Lord:
he indeed I — Śiva-natured, from firmness Śiva.
vbt-p11-v109.sanskrit_cite: sarvajñaḥ sarvakartā ca vyāpakaḥ parameśvaraḥ | sa evāhaṃ śaivadharmā iti dārḍhyāc chivo bhavet

lines: Water's waves, flame-plays of fire, sun's light:
mine and Bhairava's — world-plays manifest only.
vbt-p11-v110.sanskrit_cite: jalasyevormayo vahner jvālābhaṅgyaḥ prabhā raveḥ | mamaiva bhairavasyaitā viśvabhaṅgyo vibheditāḥ

lines: Whirled, whirled, body swiftly fallen earth-ward:
agitation-power ceasing — supreme state born.
vbt-p12-v111.sanskrit_cite: bhrāntvā bhrāntvā śarīreṇa tvaritam bhuvi pātanāt | kṣobhaśaktivirāmeṇa parā saṃjāyate daśā

lines: Supports or power, knowing, or mind-dissolving:
power-penetration's end — Bhairava form.
vbt-p12-v112.sanskrit_cite: ādhāreṣv athavā 'śaktyā 'jñānāc cittalayena vā | jātaśaktisamāveśakṣobhānte bhairavaṃ vapuḥ

lines: Tradition this, Goddess, hear — rightly I tell:
even freedom born at once — eyes unwinkering fixed.
vbt-p12-v113.sanskrit_cite: sampradāyam imam devi śṛṇu samyag vadāmy aham | kaivalyaṃ jāyate sadyo netrayoḥ stabdhamātrayoḥ

lines: Ear-contraction, at lower gate likewise:
unsmeared, unploughed, meditating — eternal brahman entered.
vbt-p12-v114.sanskrit_cite: saṃkocaṃ karṇayoḥ kṛtvā hy adhodvāre tathaiva ca | anackam ahalaṃ dhyāyan viśed brahma sanātanam

lines: Above well and great pit, standing, from looking:
undivided mind rightly — mind dissolving plainly.
vbt-p12-v115.sanskrit_cite: kūpādike mahāgarte sthitvopari nirīkṣaṇāt | avikalpamateḥ samyak sadyas cittalayaḥ sphuṭam

lines: Wherever mind — outside, inside, or even:
there Śiva-state, by pervasiveness: where would it go?
vbt-p12-v116.sanskrit_cite: yatra yatra mano yāti bāhye vābhyantare 'pi vā | tatra tatra śivāvāsthā vyāpakatvāt kva yāsyati

lines: Wherever eye-road — consciousness manifested, pervader's:
his, only-that-natured, cit-dissolving — full-selfness.
vbt-p12-v117.sanskrit_cite: yatra yatrākṣamārgeṇa caitanyaṃ vyajyate vibhoḥ | tasya tanmātradharmitvāc cillayād bharitātmatā

lines: Hunger's end, fear, grief, abyss, battle fled:
curiosity-thirst's end — reality-being-full state.
vbt-p12-v118.sanskrit_cite: kṣutādyante bhaye śoke gahvare vā raṇād drute | kutūhalekṣudhādyante brahmasattāmayī daśā

lines: Things remembered, seen, in place mind leave:
own body unsupported — lord spreads forth.
vbt-p12-v119.sanskrit_cite: vastuṣu smaryamāṇeṣu dṛṣṭe deśe manas tyajet | svaśarīraṃ nirādhāraṃ kṛtvā prasarati prabhuḥ

lines: Anywhere on thing placed — slowly gaze withdraw:
mind-with that knowing — Goddess, void-abode.
vbt-p12-v120.sanskrit_cite: kvacid vastuni vinyasya śanair dṛṣṭiṃ nivartayet | taj jñānaṃ cittasahitaṃ devi śūnyālāyo bhavet

lines: Devotion's excess, dispassionate's mind arisen:
her, power, Śaṅkara's — contemplate always: Śiva then.
vbt-p13-v121.sanskrit_cite: bhaktyudrekād viraktasya yādṛśī jāyate matiḥ | sā śaktiḥ śāṅkarī nityam bhavayet tāṃ tataḥ śivaḥ

lines: In things inside, in all things voidness:
her meditated even — known, becomes calm.
vbt-p13-v122.sanskrit_cite: vastvantare vedyamāne sarvavastuṣu śūnyatā | tām eva manasā dhyātvā vidito 'pi praśāmyati

lines: Slightly knowing remembered purity — Śambhu's view:
neither pure nor impure — thought-free, happy may be.
vbt-p13-v123.sanskrit_cite: kiṃcijjñair yā smṛtā śuddhiḥ sā śuddhiḥ śambhudarśane | na śucir hy aśucis tasmān nirvikalpaḥ sukhī bhavet

lines: Everywhere Bhairava-state, in common things even:
not beyond — nondual going.
vbt-p13-v124.sanskrit_cite: sarvatra bhairavo bhāvaḥ sāmānyeṣv api gocaraḥ | na ca tadvyatirekteṇa paro 'stīty advayā gatiḥ

lines: Same in enemy and friend, honor, dishonor:
brahma's fullness known — happy may be.
vbt-p13-v125.sanskrit_cite: samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca samo mānāvamānayoḥ || brahmaṇaḥ paripūrṇatvāt iti jñātvā sukhī bhavet

lines: No hatred contemplated anywhere, no passion:
free of both — brahman glides forth middle.
vbt-p13-v126.sanskrit_cite: na dveṣam bhāvayet kvāpi na rāgam bhāvayet kvacit | rāgadveṣavinirmuktau madhye brahma prasarpati

lines: Unknowable, ungraspable, void, gone to nonbeing:
all as Bhairava contemplated — at end awakening arises.
vbt-p13-v127.sanskrit_cite: yad avedyaṃ yad agrāhyaṃ yac chūnyaṃ yad abhāvagam | tat sarvam bhairavam bhāvyaṃ tadante bodhasambhavaḥ

lines: Eternal, supportless, void, pervasive, counting-free:
mind in outer sky made — into skyless entered.
vbt-p13-v128.sanskrit_cite: nitye nirāśraye śūnye vyāpake kalanojjhite | bāhyākāśe manaḥ kṛtvā nirākāśaṃ samāviśet

lines: Wherever mind — that, that by that at that moment:
non-standing left — waveless then may be.
vbt-p13-v129.sanskrit_cite: yatra yatra mano yāti tat tat tenaiva tatkṣaṇam | parityajyānavasthityā nistaraṅgas tato bhavet

lines: Fear resounds all, giving-all pervasive wholeness:
of Bhairava-word, constant uttering — Śiva.
vbt-p13-v130.sanskrit_cite: bhayā sarvaṃ ravayati sarvado vyāpako 'khile | iti bhairavaśabdasya santatoccāraṇāc chivaḥ

lines: 'I', 'mine', 'this' and such — conviction's doing:
supportless mind goes — meditation's impulse, calm.
vbt-p14-v131.sanskrit_cite: ahaṃ mamedam ityādi pratipattiprasaṅgataḥ | nirādhāre mano yāti taddhyānapreraṇāc chamī

lines: Eternal, all-pervading, supportless, all-lord:
words meditated moment by moment — meaning-aimed done.
vbt-p14-v132.sanskrit_cite: nityo vibhur nirādhāro vyāpakaś cākhilādhipaḥ | śabdān pratikṣaṇaṃ dhyāyan kṛtārtho 'rthānurūpataḥ

lines: Non-reality, Indra-net-shine, all standing:
what reality of net? From firmness — calm goes.
vbt-p14-v133.sanskrit_cite: atattvam indrajālābham idaṃ sarvam avasthitam | kiṃ tattvam indrajālasya iti dārḍhyāc chamaṃ vrajet

lines: Self unwavering — where knowing, where action?
knowing-dependent outer states — void, this world.
vbt-p14-v134.sanskrit_cite: ātmano nirvikārasya kva jñānaṃ kva ca vā kriyā | jñānāyattā bahirbhāvā ataḥ śūnyam idaṃ jagat

lines: Not of me bondage, not freedom — frightened's terrors:
this reflection of intellect in waters, sun's.
vbt-p14-v135.sanskrit_cite: na me bandho na mokṣo me bhītasyaitā vibhīṣikāḥ | pratibimbam idam buddher jaleṣv iva vivasvataḥ

lines: Sense-doored all, meeting pleasure pain and such:
senses left — self-abiding in own self abides.
vbt-p14-v136.sanskrit_cite: indriyadvārakaṃ sarvaṃ sukhaduḥkhādisaṃgamam | itīndriyāṇi saṃtyajya svasthaḥ svātmani vartate

lines: Knowing-lighting all, by all self lighting:
one from one-nature — knowing-knowable envisioned.
vbt-p14-v137.sanskrit_cite: jñānaprakāśakaṃ sarvaṃ sarveṇātmā prakāśakaḥ | ekam ekasvabhāvatvāt jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ vibhāvyate

lines: Mental, consciousness, power, self, mind — fourfold:
when wasted fully, O dear — then Bhairava form.
vbt-p14-v138.sanskrit_cite: mānasaṃ cetanā śaktir ātmā ceti catuṣṭayam | yadā priye parikṣīṇaṃ tadā tad bhairavaṃ vapuḥ

lines: Waveless teachings hundred told in brief, twelve-plus:
which knowing, O Goddess — knowing-knower person.
vbt-p14-v139.sanskrit_cite: nistaraṅgopadeśānāṃ śatam uktaṃ samāsataḥ | dvādaśābhyadhikaṃ devi yaj jñātvā jñānavij janaḥ

lines: Here and in one yoked — Bhairava himself becomes:
by speech deeds does — curse-and-favor making.
vbt-p14-v140.sanskrit_cite: atra caikatame yukto jāyate bhairavaḥ svayam | vācā karoti karmāṇi śāpānugrahakārakaḥ

lines: Ageless deathlessness attains he, atom-qualities endowed:
of yoginīs dear — the all-gathering lord.
vbt-p15-v141.sanskrit_cite: ajarāmaratām eti so 'ṇimādiguṇānvitaḥ | yoginīnām priyo devi sarvamelāpakādhipaḥ

lines: Living even, freed; acting even — not smeared:
this body — if of supreme and great lord, O god.
vbt-p15-v142.sanskrit_cite: jīvann api vimukto 'sau kurvann api na lipyate | idaṃ yadi vapur deva parāyāś ca maheśvara

lines: In state told thus — who mutes, who meditates, worships?
who pleased, O great lord?
vbt-p15-v143.sanskrit_cite: evamuktavyavasthāyāṃ japyate ko japaś ca kaḥ | dhyāyate ko mahānātha pūjyate kaś ca tṛpyati

lines: Whose oblation, whose sacrifice — what, how?
this here procedure outer, in gross things, deer-eyed.
vbt-p15-v144.sanskrit_cite: hūyate kasya vā homo yāgaḥ kasya ca kiṃ katham | eṣātra prakriyā bāhyā sthūleṣv eva mṛgekṣaṇe

lines: Again, again supreme state: which contemplation contemplates:
muttering there — self-sound, mantra-natured, such.
vbt-p15-v145.sanskrit_cite: bhūyo bhūyaḥ pare bhāve bhāvanā bhāvyate hi yā | japaḥ so 'tra svayaṃ nādo mantrātmā japya īdṛśaḥ

lines: Meditation: unmoving intellect, formless, supportless;
not meditation: body-eye-mouth-hand imagining.
vbt-p15-v146.sanskrit_cite: dhyānaṃ hi niścalā buddhir nirākārā nirāśrayā | na tu dhyānaṃ śarīrākṣimukhahastādikalpanā

lines: Worship named: not by flowers — mind made firm:
in undifferentiated great sky: from care dissolving.
vbt-p15-v147.sanskrit_cite: pūjā nāma na puṣpādyair yā matiḥ kriyate dṛḍhā | nirvikalpe mahāvyomni sā pūjā hy ādarāl layaḥ

lines: Here in one-yoking standing, from day to day:
full-formed state — contentment here, utter fullness.
vbt-p15-v148.sanskrit_cite: atraikatamayuktisthe yotpadyeta dinād dinam | bharitākāratā sātra tṛptir atyantapūrṇatā

lines: Great void-abode, in fire: sense-objects and such:
offered by mind, oblation all, awareness-ladle.
vbt-p15-v149.sanskrit_cite: mahāśūnyālaye vahnau bhūtākṣaviṣayādikam | hūyate manasā sārdhaṃ sa homaś cetanāsrucā

lines: Sacrifice here, highest lady — contentment, bliss-marked:
wasting all sins, protecting all — mountain's daughter.
vbt-p15-v150.sanskrit_cite: yāgo 'tra parameśāni tuṣṭir ānandalakṣaṇā | kṣapaṇāt sarvapāpānāṃ trāṇāt sarvasya pārvati

lines: Rudra-power-penetration: that field, contemplation supreme:
otherwise of it — what worship, which pleased?
vbt-p16-v151.sanskrit_cite: rudraśaktisamāveśas tat kṣetram bhāvanā parā | anyathā tasya tattvasya kā pūjā kāś ca tṛpyati

lines: Free-bliss-consciousness-mere-essence — self everywhere:
entering that form: own-self's bath, declared.
vbt-p16-v152.sanskrit_cite: svatantrānandacinmātrasāraḥ svātmā hi sarvataḥ | āveśanaṃ tatsvarūpe svātmanaḥ snānam īritam

lines: By which worshipped, materials please, or higher-lower:
who worshipper? all he, very one: where the worship?
vbt-p16-v153.sanskrit_cite: yair eva pūjyate dravyais tarpyate vā parāparaḥ | yaś caiva pūjakaḥ sarvaḥ sa evaikaḥ kva pūjanam

lines: Breath goes, life enters — will, crooked-formed:
long-formed she, great goddess: other field, higher-lower.
vbt-p16-v154.sanskrit_cite: vrajet prāṇo viśej jīva icchayā kuṭilākṛtiḥ | dīrghātmā sā mahādevī parakṣetram parāparā

lines: In this walking, standing in great-bliss-path:
by her entered — supreme Bhairava attained.
vbt-p16-v155.sanskrit_cite: asyām anucaran tiṣṭhan mahānandamaye 'dhvare | tayā devyā samāviṣṭaḥ param bhairavam āpnuyāt

lines: Six hundreds day, thousand twenty-one by night:
goddess's muting declared — easy, hard for dull.
vbt-p16-v156.sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭśatāni divā rātrau sahasrāṇyekaviṃśatiḥ | japo devyāḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ sulabho durlabho jaḍaiḥ

lines: Thus told, Goddess — supreme nectar, highest:
never to be shown of anyone, but ever.
vbt-p16-v157.sanskrit_cite: ity etat kathitaṃ devi paramāmṛtam uttamam | etac ca naiva kasyāpi prakāśyaṃ tu kadācana

lines: To another pupil, base, cruel, non-devoted:
but to thought-free heroes, lofty-souled — guru's feet.
vbt-p16-v158.sanskrit_cite: paraśiṣye khale krūre abhakte gurupādayoḥ | nirvikalpamatīnāṃ tu vīrāṇām unnatātmanām

lines: To devotees, guru's company: given unhedged:
village, kingdom, town, country, son, wife, kin.
vbt-p16-v159.sanskrit_cite: bhaktānāṃ guruvargasya dātavyaṃ nirviśaṅkayā | grāmo rājyam puraṃ deśaḥ putradārakuṭumbakam

lines: All this left — grasped, this, deer-eyed:
unsteady what? steady this supreme wealth; lives given, nectar not.
vbt-p16-v160.sanskrit_cite: sarvam etat parityajya grāhyam etan mṛgekṣaṇe | kim ebhir asthirair devi sthiram param idaṃ dhanam | prāṇā api pradātavyā na deyaṃ paramāmṛtam

lines: God of gods, great god — content am I, Śaṅkara:
Rudrayāmala-tantra's essence, held today.
vbt-p17-v161.sanskrit_cite: devadeva māhadeva paritṛptāsmi śaṅkara | rudrayāmalatantrasya sāram adyāvadhāritam

lines: Heart of all power-divisions known today:
spoken, delighted — goddess on neck, to Śiva's clung.
vbt-p17-v162.sanskrit_cite: sarvaśaktiprabhedānāṃ hṛdayaṃ jñātam adya ca | ity uktvānanditā devi ka.ṅthe lagnā śivasya tu

lines: Heard by me, all — Rudrayāmala-born:
the Trika's divisions, essence by essence run.
vbt-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: śrutaṃ deva mayā sarvaṃ rudrayāmalasambhavam | trikabhedam aśeṣeṇa sārāt sāravibhāgaśaḥ

lines: Even now the doubt is not dispelled in me —
what form is it in truth, made of word-heap and digit?
vbt-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: adyāpi na nivṛtto me saṃśayaḥ parameśvara | kiṃ rūpaṃ tattvato deva śabdarāśikalāmayam

lines: Nine-self division? Bhairava in his form?
three-head split? power-triad? which is it?
vbt-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ vā navātmabhedena bhairave bhairavākṛtau | triśirobhedabhinnaṃ vā kiṃ vā śaktitrayātmakam

lines: Nāda's drop, the moon-crescent's checks —
or wheel-mounted, unsmeared: power-formed, what?
vbt-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: nādabindumayaṃ vāpi kiṃ candrārdhanirodhikāḥ | cakrārūḍham anackaṃ vā kiṃ vā śaktisvarūpakam

lines: Higher and lower, whole: and of the lower —
if higher then were that, its higher-ness contradicts.
vbt-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: parāparāyāḥ sakalam aparāyāś ca vā punaḥ | parāyā yadi tadvat syāt paratvaṃ tad virudhyate

lines: Not by letter-division, nor by bodies divided:
higher-ness is partlessness — that, not, in wholeness.
vbt-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: na hi varṇavibhedena dehabhedena vā bhavet | paratvaṃ niṣkalatvena sakalatve na tad bhavet

lines: Grant grace, O Lord — cut the doubt entire:
what you were asked, is the tantra's very essence.
vbt-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: prasādaṃ kuru me nātha niḥśeṣaṃ chinddhi saṃśayam | sādhu sādhu tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ tantrasāram idam priye

lines: Most worthy of hiding, fortunate one —
yet will I tell you: all Bhairava's form, proclaimed.
vbt-p01-v08.sanskrit_cite: gūhanīyatamam bhadre tathāpi kathayāmi te | yatkiṃcit sakalaṃ rūpaṃ bhairavasya prakīrtitam

lines: Known by its own unsubstantialness, Goddess —
Indra-net, māyā's dream, the Gandharva-city's error.
vbt-p01-v09.sanskrit_cite: tad asāratayā devi vijñeyaṃ śakrajālavat | māyāsvapnopamaṃ caiva gandharvanagarabhramam

lines: For meditation's sake — confused minds, pompous-rite
dwellers: described merely, fancy-struck men.
vbt-p01-v10.sanskrit_cite: dhyānārtham bhrāntabuddhīnāṃ kriyāḍambaravartinām | kevalaṃ varṇitam puṃsāṃ vikalpanihatātmanām

lines: Not nine-self, not word-heap, not Bhairava —
not three-headed god, not power-triad's nature.
vbt-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: tattvato na navātmāsau śabdarāśir na bhairavaḥ | na cāsau triśirā devo na ca śaktitrayātmakaḥ

lines: Not nāda-drop, not moon's checks, not wheel-joined —
not power-formed.
vbt-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: nādabindumayo vāpi na candrārdhanirodhikāḥ | na cakrakramasambhinno na ca śaktisvarūpakaḥ

lines: For unawakened minds these are strong terrors;
like mother's sweet — all for the sake of going on.
vbt-p02-v13.sanskrit_cite: aprabuddhamatīnāṃ hi etā balavibhīṣikāḥ | mātṛmodakavat sarvaṃ pravṛttyarthaṃ udāhṛtam

lines: Free of direction, time and counting, place-point
unspecified: untellable, ultimately unpointable.
vbt-p02-v14.sanskrit_cite: dikkālakalanonmuktā deśoddeśāviśeṣinī | vyapadeṣṭum aśakyāsāv akathyā paramārthataḥ

lines: Joy within — inner self-taste, unhoused in fancy:
that full-formed state — Bhairavī of Bhairava's self.
vbt-p02-v15.sanskrit_cite: antaḥsvānubhavānandā vikalponmuktagocarā | yāvasthā bharitākārā bhairavī bhairavātmanaḥ

lines: That body must be known in truth — stainless,
world-filling: who worships, which pleased, in such reality?
vbt-p02-v16.sanskrit_cite: tad vapus tattvato jñeyaṃ vimalaṃ viśvapūraṇam | evaṃvidhe pare tattve kaḥ pūjyaḥ kaś ca tṛpyati

lines: Whatever state of Bhairava's is sung like this —
she is supreme: supreme goddess in supreme form.
vbt-p02-v17.sanskrit_cite: evaṃvidhā bhairavasya yāvasthā parigīyate | sā parā pararūpeṇa parā devī prakīrtitā

lines: As power-and-powerful non-difference stands always,
hence: supreme power of the supreme self.
vbt-p02-v18.sanskrit_cite: śaktiśaktimator yadvad abhedaḥ sarvadā sthitaḥ | atas taddharmadharmitvāt parā śaktiḥ parātmanaḥ

lines: No burning-power of fire is separate — conceived so;
only in knowing-being, in entering, the beginning starts.
vbt-p02-v19.sanskrit_cite: na vahner dāhikā śaktir vyatiriktā vibhāvyate | kevalaṃ jñānasattāyām prārambho 'yam praveśane

lines: Of one entered the power-state, contemplation
undivided: then he Śiva-formed — the mouth is called Śaivī.
vbt-p02-v20.sanskrit_cite: śaktyavasthāpraviṣṭasya nirvibhāgena bhāvanā | tadāsau śivarūpī syāt śaivī mukham ihocyate

lines: As lamp-light, rays, and sun disclose
direction and division — so by power, Śiva, O dear.
vbt-p03-v21.sanskrit_cite: yathālokena dīpasya kiraṇair bhāskarasya ca | jñāyate digvibhāgādi tadvac chaktyā śivaḥ priye

lines: God of gods, trident-marked, skull-adorned —
void of direction, place and time: designation-free.
vbt-p03-v22.sanskrit_cite: devadeva triśūlāṅka kapālakṛtabhūṣaṇa | digdeśakālaśūnyā ca vyapadeśavivarjitā

lines: What full-formed state of Bhairava is got, by which
means his door, O Goddess? Tell as you rightly know.
vbt-p03-v23.sanskrit_cite: yāvasthā bharitākārā bhairavasyopalabhyate | kair upāyair mukhaṃ tasya parā devi katham bhavet | yathā samyag ahaṃ vedmi tathā me brūhi bhairava

lines: Breath above, life below, the emission-natured —
uttering forth: at two arising places, filled, standing.
vbt-p03-v24.sanskrit_cite: ūrdhve prāṇo hy adho jīvo visargātmā paroccaret | utpattidvitayasthāne bharaṇād bharitā sthitiḥ

lines: Of wind within or outside, sky-pair not turning —
by Bhairavī, of Bhairava thus: the manifested form.
vbt-p03-v25.sanskrit_cite: maruto 'ntar bahir vāpi viyadyugmānivartanāt | bhairavyā bhairavasyettham bhairavi vyajyate vapuḥ

lines: Neither should it go nor enter, wind-blossomed power:
by thoughtlessness in middle — Bhairava-formness, by her.
vbt-p03-v26.sanskrit_cite: na vrajen na viśec chaktir marudrūpā vikāsite | nirvikalpatayā madhye tayā bhairavarūpatā

lines: Kumbhaka-held or exhaled or inhaled, whenever so —
at its end this is calm: by power, calm shines forth.
vbt-p03-v27.sanskrit_cite: kumbhitā recitā vāpi pūritā vā yadā bhavet | tadante śāntanāmāsau śaktyā śāntaḥ prakāśate

lines: From root ray-shining, from subtle subtler-natured:
contemplate her at twelve's end — calming, Bhairava's rise.
vbt-p03-v28.sanskrit_cite: āmūlāt kiraṇābhāsāṃ sūkṣmāt sūkṣmatarātmikam | cintayet tāṃ dviṣaṭkānte śyāmyantīm bhairavodayaḥ

lines: Rising lightning-formed, wheel by wheel in step;
upward three fists — until: then at end, great rise.
vbt-p03-v29.sanskrit_cite: udgacchantīṃ taḍitrūpām praticakraṃ kramāt kramam | ūrdhvaṃ muṣṭitrayaṃ yāvat tāvad ante mahodayaḥ

lines: Twelvefold course rightly, twelve letters divided;
through gross, subtle, supreme: freed at end — Śiva.
vbt-p03-v30.sanskrit_cite: kramadvādaśakaṃ samyag dvādaśākṣarabheditam | sthūlasūkṣmaparasthityā muktvā muktvāntataḥ śivaḥ

lines: By that quick filling, crown-end broken, brow-toss bridge:
thought-free mind made — above all, all go forth.
vbt-p04-v31.sanskrit_cite: tayāpūryāśu mūrdhāntaṃ bhaṅktvā bhrūkṣepasetunā | nirvikalpaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā sarvordhve sarvagodgamaḥ

lines: Peacock feathers, varied forms, circles — five-void:
of the meditating, unsurpassed void: entry in heart.
vbt-p04-v32.sanskrit_cite: śikhipakṣaiś citrarūpair ma.ṅdalaiḥ śūnyapañcakam | dhyāyato 'nuttare śūnye praveśo hṛdaye bhavet

lines: By just such course — wherever thought: void, wall,
supreme, vessel: self dissolved, boon-giving.
vbt-p04-v33.sanskrit_cite: īdṛśena krameṇaiva yatra kutrāpi cintanā | śūnye kuḍye pare pātre svayaṃ līnā varapradā

lines: Mind in skull placed, half-closed-eyed standing:
from mind's firmness in order — mark the highest mark.
vbt-p04-v34.sanskrit_cite: kapālāntar mano nyasya tiṣṭhan mīlitalocanaḥ | krameṇa manaso dārḍhyāt lakṣayet laṣyam uttamam

lines: Middle channel, mid-standing, lotus-fiber-like:
by meditated inner sky, Goddess — god shines through.
vbt-p04-v35.sanskrit_cite: madhyanāḍī madhyasaṃsthā bisasūtrābharūpayā | dhyātāntarvyomayā devyā tayā devaḥ prakāśate

lines: Hand-blocked gaze, brow-split, door-blocked:
seen in drop, dissolved in order — middle, supreme standing.
vbt-p04-v36.sanskrit_cite: kararuddhadṛgastreṇa bhrūbhedād dvārarodhanāt | dṛṣṭe bindau kramāl līne tanmadhye paramā sthitiḥ

lines: Dwelling-inner-churn's fire-tilak, drop at crest's end,
heart, dissolution-end: meditating, dissolving.
vbt-p04-v37.sanskrit_cite: dhāmāntaḥkṣobhasambhūtasūkṣmāgnitilakākṛtim | binduṃ śikhānte hṛdaye layānte dhyāyato layaḥ

lines: Unstruck, vessel-ear, broken sound, river-rushing:
bathed in word-brahman — supreme brahman attained.
vbt-p04-v38.sanskrit_cite: anāhate pātrakarṇe 'bhagnaśabde sariddrute | śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ param brahmādhigacchati

lines: Prolonged oṃ-uttering, at its end, void contemplated:
by void, by supreme power — to voidness goes, Bhairavī.
vbt-p04-v39.sanskrit_cite: praṇavādisamuccārāt plutānte śūnyabhāvānāt | śūnyayā parayā śaktyā śūnyatām eti bhairavi

lines: Any letter's beginning and end contemplated:
by void become void — void-formed the man becomes.
vbt-p04-v40.sanskrit_cite: yasya kasyāpi varṇasya pūrvāntāv anubhāvayet | śūnyayā śūnyabhūto 'sau śūnyākāraḥ pumān bhavet

lines: Stringed instruments' long tones, ordered resonance:
undivided mind at limit — supreme-sky body.
vbt-p05-v41.sanskrit_cite: tantryādivādyaśabdeṣu dīrgheṣu kramasaṃsthiteḥ | ananyacetāḥ pratyante paravyomavapur bhavet

lines: Body-mantra's gross course, ending moon-drop-sound:
void uttering — one may become Śiva.
vbt-p05-v42.sanskrit_cite: pi.ṅdamantrasya sarvasya sthūlavarṇakrameṇa tu | ardhendubindunādāntaḥ śūnyoccārād bhavec chivaḥ

lines: In own body all directions at once as sky:
undirected mind — of him sky proceeds all through.
vbt-p05-v43.sanskrit_cite: nijadehe sarvadikkaṃ yugapad bhāvayed viyat | nirvikalpamanās tasya viyat sarvam pravartate

lines: Back-void, root-void at once contemplated, who so —
by body-disregarding power, void-minded may be.
vbt-p05-v44.sanskrit_cite: pṛṣṭaśūnyaṃ mūlaśūnyaṃ yugapad bhāvayec ca yaḥ | śarīranirapekṣiṇyā śaktyā śūnyamanā bhavet

lines: Back, root, heart voids steady contemplated:
at once from thoughtlessness — thoughtless-rising then.
vbt-p05-v45.sanskrit_cite: pṛṣṭaśūnyaṃ mūlaśūnyaṃ hṛcchūnyam bhāvayet sthiram | yugapan nirvikalpatvān nirvikalpodayas tataḥ

lines: On body-place voidness indeed, mere moment:
thoughtless, thoughtless — sharing thoughtless nature.
vbt-p05-v46.sanskrit_cite: tanūdeśe śūnyataiva kṣaṇamātraṃ vibhāvayet | nirvikalpaṃ nirvikalpo nirvikalpasvarūpabhāk

lines: All gone in body-stuff, sky-pervaded, deer-eyed:
envisioned then — of him contemplation steadies.
vbt-p05-v47.sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ dehagataṃ dravyaṃ viyadvyāptaṃ mṛgekṣaṇe | vibhāvayet tatas tasya bhāvanā sā sthirā bhavet

lines: Inside body, skin-division wall-like think through:
nothing inside — unmeditated-sharer may be.
vbt-p05-v48.sanskrit_cite: dehāntare tvagvibhāgam bhittibhūtaṃ vicintayet | na kiṃcid antare tasya dhyāyann adhyeyabhāg bhavet

lines: In heart-sky, eyes hidden, mid lotus-casket gone:
undivided-minded, fortunate — supreme fortune won.
vbt-p05-v49.sanskrit_cite: hṛdyākāśe nilīnākṣaḥ padmasampuṭamadhyagaḥ | ananyacetāḥ subhage paraṃ saubhāgyam āpnuyāt

lines: From all around own body, twelve-end, mind-dissolving:
firm-minded made firm — the reality-mark proceeds.
vbt-p05-v50.sanskrit_cite: sarvataḥ svaśarīrasya dvādaśānte manolayāt | dṛḍhabuddher dṛḍhībhūtaṃ tattvalakṣyam pravartate

lines: As thus where there, twelve-end the mind should cast:
moment by moment — strangeness of turning drops in days.
vbt-p06-v51.sanskrit_cite: yathā tathā yatra tatra dvādaśānte manaḥ kṣipet || pratikṣaṇaṃ kṣīṇavṛtter vailakṣaṇyaṃ dinair bhavet

lines: By time-fire from time-place risen, own city burnt:
at end calm-shining — then it may be.
vbt-p06-v52.sanskrit_cite: kālāgninā kālapadād utthitena svakam puram | pluṣṭam vicintayed ante śāntābhāsas tadā bhavet

lines: Thus world all burnt, fancy burned through:
in non-other mind of man — man-ness supreme.
vbt-p06-v53.sanskrit_cite: evam eva jagat sarvaṃ dagdhaṃ dhyātvā vikalpataḥ | ananyacetasaḥ puṃsaḥ pumbhāvaḥ paramo bhavet

lines: In own body, world's or minute-minuter things and
realities' abiding at end — the supreme manifested.
vbt-p06-v54.sanskrit_cite: svadehe jagato vāpi sūkṣmasūkṣmatarāṇi ca | tattvāni yāni nilayaṃ dhyātvānte vyajyate parā

lines: Thin, weak power meditated at twelve's range,
entered, heart-meditating: freed — freedom won.
vbt-p06-v55.sanskrit_cite: pināṃ ca durbalāṃ śaktiṃ dhyātvā dvādaśagocare | praviśya hṛdaye dhyāyan muktaḥ svātantryam āpnuyāt

lines: World-course and rest formed, in order, all:
gross-subtle-supreme standing — till mind dissolves at end.
vbt-p06-v56.sanskrit_cite: bhuvanādhvādirūpeṇa cintayet kramaśo 'khilam | sthūlasūkṣmaparasthityā yāvad ante manolayaḥ

lines: Of this, of all, of world, at ends everywhere:
Śiva-reality meditated by path-procedure — great rise.
vbt-p06-v57.sanskrit_cite: asya sarvasya viśvasya paryanteṣu samantataḥ | adhvaprakriyayā tattvaṃ śaivaṃ dhyatvā mahodayaḥ

lines: Universe this, great Goddess, void-become think:
mind merged right there — that merging's vessel.
vbt-p06-v58.sanskrit_cite: viśvam etan mahādevi śūnyabhūtaṃ vicintayet | tatraiva ca mano līnaṃ tatas tallayabhājanam

lines: In pot and such a vessel, gaze — wall left, cast well:
at that dissolving, moment gone — made-of-that may be.
vbt-p06-v59.sanskrit_cite: ghatādibhājane dṛṣṭim bhittis tyaktvā vinikṣipet | tallayaṃ tatkṣaṇād gatvā tallayāt tanmayo bhavet

lines: Treeless mountain, wall, such place: gaze cast well;
mind dissolved in state — the wasting of turning is born.
vbt-p06-v60.sanskrit_cite: nirvṛkṣagiribhittyādideśe dṛṣṭiṃ vinikṣipet | vilīne mānase bhāve vṛttikṣiṇaḥ prajāyate

lines: Both states, knowing meditated — the middle resort to:
at once, both left — in middle reality shines forth.
vbt-p07-v61.sanskrit_cite: ubhayor bhāvayor jñāne dhyātvā madhyaṃ samāśrayet | yugapac ca dvayaṃ tyaktvā madhye tattvam prakāśate

lines: State abandoned, restrained consciousness goes no-where-else:
then in that middle-being — contemplation expands exceedingly.
vbt-p07-v62.sanskrit_cite: bhāve tyakte niruddhā cin naiva bhāvāntaraṃ vrajet | tadā tanmadhyabhāvena vikasatyati bhāvanā

lines: All body consciousness-made, or world, fancy fully:
at once by undivided mind — supreme rise.
vbt-p07-v63.sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ dehaṃ cinmayaṃ hi jagad vā paribhāvayet | yugapan nirvikalpena manasā paramodayaḥ

lines: Two winds, clashing, inside or outside at limit:
yogin — of evenness-knowing's rise, the offering-vessel.
vbt-p07-v64.sanskrit_cite: vāyudvayasya saṃghaṭṭād antar vā bahir antataḥ | yogī samatvavijñānasamudgamanabhājanam

lines: All world or own body, with own bliss filled, remember:
at once with own nectar — full of supreme bliss may be.
vbt-p07-v65.sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ jagat svadehaṃ vā svānandabharitaṃ smaret | yugapat svāmṛtenaiva parānandamayo bhavet

lines: By trick, by application, at once, deer-eyed:
great bliss manifests — by which reality shines.
vbt-p07-v66.sanskrit_cite: kuhanena prayogeṇa sadya eva mṛgekṣaṇe | samudeti mahānando yena tattvaṃ prakāśate

lines: Channels all bound, up-breath power, slowly:
at the crawling ant's time — supreme happiness spreads.
vbt-p07-v67.sanskrit_cite: sarvasrotonibandhena prāṇaśaktyordhvayā śanaiḥ | pipīlasparśavelāyām prathate paramaṃ sukham

lines: Fire and poison, middle: mind happiness-made cast —
mere wind-filled, or yoked by remembrance-bliss.
vbt-p07-v68.sanskrit_cite: vahner viṣasya madhye tu cittaṃ sukhamayaṃ kṣipet | kevalaṃ vāyupūrṇaṃ vā smarānandena yujyate

lines: Agitated by union, shaking, power-penetration's end:
whatever brahman-reality's happiness — self-told, that told.
vbt-p07-v69.sanskrit_cite: śaktisaṃgamasaṃkṣubdhaśaktyāveśāvasānikam | yat sukham brahmatattvasya tat sukhaṃ svākyam ucyate

lines: Licking, churning, pounding's apex — woman-bliss from
fullness, from memory: power-absent, bliss-flood may be.
vbt-p07-v70.sanskrit_cite: lehanāmanthanākoṭaiḥ strīsukhasya bharāt smṛteḥ | śaktyabhāve 'pi deveśi bhaved ānandasamplavaḥ

lines: In joy, great, won — seen or kinsman long after:
bliss risen, meditated — dissolved in that, of that mind may be.
vbt-p08-v71.sanskrit_cite: ānande mahati prāpte dṛṣṭe vā bāndhave cirāt | ānandam udgataṃ dhyātvā tallayas tanmanā bhavet

lines: Eating, drinking, joy's swelling, bliss-blooming:
fancy the filled state — great bliss then may be.
vbt-p08-v72.sanskrit_cite: jagdhipānakṛtollāsarasānandavijṛmbhaṇāt | bhāvayed bharitāvasthāṃ mahānandas tato bhavet

lines: Objects-tasting such as song — happiness unshared,
one-selfness: absorbedness mounted — that selfness.
Where mind content — there right the mind should hold:
there, there — supreme-bliss-own-form proceeds forth.
vbt-p08-v74.sanskrit_cite: yatra yatra manas tuṣṭir manas tatraiva dhārayet | tatra tatra parānandasvārūpaṃ sampravartate

lines: In not-yet-come, in sleep, outer range perished:
that state to be gone by mind — supreme Goddess shines.
vbt-p08-v75.sanskrit_cite: anāgatāyāṃ nidrāyām praṇaṣṭe bāhyagocare | sāvasthā manasā gamyā parā devī prakāśate

lines: Sun, lamp brilliance, dappled sky:
gaze fixed right there — own self-form shines.
vbt-p08-v76.sanskrit_cite: tejasā sūryadīpāder ākāśe śabalīkṛte | dṛṣṭir niveśyā tatraiva svātmarūpam prakāśate

lines: By skeleton, angry, licking Bhairavī, sky-going:
at gaze's time — supreme attainment shines.
vbt-p08-v77.sanskrit_cite: karaṅkiṇyā krodhanayā bhairavyā lelihānayā | khecaryā dṛṣṭikāle ca parāvāptiḥ prakāśate

lines: Soft seat, one buttock, hands feet unsupported:
by that context — supreme full mind may be.
vbt-p08-v78.sanskrit_cite: mṛdvāsane sphijaikena hastapādau nirāśrayam | nidhāya tatprasaṅgena parā pūrṇā matir bhavet

lines: Seated rightly, arms two half-bent:
armpit-sky mind-making — calm comes by dissolving.
vbt-p08-v79.sanskrit_cite: upaviśyāsane samyag bāhū kṛtvārdhakuñcitau | kakṣavyomni manaḥ kurvan śamam āyāti tallayāt

lines: Gross-formed state's fixed gaze cast down quickly:
unsupported mind made — Śiva one may go to.
vbt-p08-v80.sanskrit_cite: sthūlarūpasya bhāvasya stabdhāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ nipātya ca | acireṇa nirādhāraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā śivaṃ vrajet

lines: Mid-tongue awareness cast, opened mouth:
h-utterance made by mind — in calm dissolves.
vbt-p09-v81.sanskrit_cite: madhyajihve sphāritāsye madhye nikṣipya cetanām | hoccāraṃ manasā kurvaṃs tataḥ śānte pralīyate

lines: Seat, bed, standing, unsupported, own-body vision:
mind wasted — in a moment impurity wastes away.
vbt-p09-v82.sanskrit_cite: āsane śayane sthitvā nirādhāraṃ vibhāvayan | svadehaṃ manasi kṣiṇe kṣaṇāt kṣīṇāśayo bhavet

lines: Moving seat, standing still or body moving:
calmed mind, in that state — Goddess, divine flood won.
vbt-p09-v83.sanskrit_cite: calāsane sthitasyātha śanair vā dehacālanāt | praśānte mānase bhāve devi divyaugham āpnuyāt

lines: Sky stainless, seeing: gaze unbroken made:
stunned self, that moment — Bhairava form won.
vbt-p09-v84.sanskrit_cite: ākāśaṃ vimalam paśyan kṛtvā dṛṣṭiṃ nirantarām | stabdhātmā tatkṣaṇād devi bhairavaṃ vapur āpnuyāt

lines: Crown dissolved, sky all as Bhairava:
that all — Bhairava-form-blaze-reality enters.
vbt-p09-v85.sanskrit_cite: līnaṃ mūrdhni viyat sarvam bhairavatvena bhāvayet | tat sarvam bhairavākāratejastattvaṃ samāviśet

lines: Something known, duality-light, darkness again:
Bhairava's universe-form — endless-light-bearing known.
vbt-p09-v86.sanskrit_cite: kiñcij jñātaṃ dvaitadāyi bāhyālokas tamaḥ punaḥ | viśvādi bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ jñātvānantaprakāśabhṛt

lines: Bad night, dark fortnight, long in it:
contemplating timira — Bhairava's form will come.
vbt-p09-v87.sanskrit_cite: evam eva durniśāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣāgame ciram | taimiram bhāvayan rūpam bhairavaṃ rūpam eṣyati

lines: Eyes closed first, black lustre before:
Bhairava's form spread — made-of-that may be.
vbt-p09-v88.sanskrit_cite: evam eva nimīlyādau netre kṛṣṇābham agrataḥ | prasārya bhairavaṃ rūpam bhāvayaṃs tanmayo bhavet

lines: Whichever organ's striking and blocking:
entered nondual void — there itself, self shines.
vbt-p09-v89.sanskrit_cite: yasya kasyendriyasyāpi vyāghātāc ca nirodhataḥ | praviṣṭasyādvaye śūnye tatraivātmā prakāśate

lines: No drop, no emission: lone a-syllable great:
rises, Goddess, sudden — knowledge-flood, highest Lord.
vbt-p09-v90.sanskrit_cite: abindum avisargaṃ ca akāraṃ japato mahān | udeti devi sahasā jñānaughaḥ parameśvaraḥ

lines: Letter with emission, emission-ending awareness:
by supportless mind — eternal brahman touched.
vbt-p10-v91.sanskrit_cite: varṇasya savisargasya visargāntaṃ citiṃ kuru | nirādhāreṇa cittena spṛśed brahma sanātanam

lines: Sky-formed own self meditated, directions uncovered:
supportless awareness-power — own form shows then.
vbt-p10-v92.sanskrit_cite: vyomākāraṃ svam ātmānaṃ dhyāyed digbhir anāvṛtam | nirāśrayā citiḥ śaktiḥ svarūpaṃ darśayet tadā

lines: Some limb pierced first, needle-etc:
right there awareness yoked — spotless going in Bhairava.
vbt-p10-v93.sanskrit_cite: kiṃcid aṅgaṃ vibhidyādau tīkṣṇasūcyādinā tataḥ | tatraiva cetanāṃ yuktvā bhairave nirmalā gatiḥ

lines: Inner-making not inside me — think thus:
fancies absent, abandoned may be.
vbt-p10-v94.sanskrit_cite: cittādyantaḥkṛtir nāsti mamāntar bhāvayed iti | vikalpānām abhāvena vikalpair ujjhito bhavet

lines: Māyā deluding, named — part-counting standing:
counting realities' such-natures — not separately may be.
vbt-p10-v95.sanskrit_cite: māyā vimohinī nāma kalāyāḥ kalanaṃ sthitam | ityādidharmaṃ tattvānāṃ kalayan na pṛthag bhavet

lines: Sudden desire arisen, seen — lead to calm:
where it arose, there right there dissolves.
vbt-p10-v96.sanskrit_cite: jhagitīcchāṃ samutpannām avalokya śamaṃ nayet | yata eva samudbhūtā tatas tatraiva līyate

lines: When my desire unarisen, knowing, or why —
then I am: truly He-I, dissolved, that-minded.
vbt-p10-v97.sanskrit_cite: yadā mamecchā notpannā jñānaṃ vā kas tadāsmi vai | tattvato =B9haṃ tathābhūtas tallīnas tanmanā bhavet

lines: In desire or knowing, when arisen, mind set:
self-mind undivided — then reality-meaning seen.
vbt-p10-v98.sanskrit_cite: icchāyām athavā jñāne jāte cittaṃ niveśayet | ātmabuddhyānanyacetās tatas tattvārthadarśanam

lines: Causeless may knowing be, supportless, error-natured:
anyone's not this — thus becoming Śiva, O dear.
vbt-p10-v99.sanskrit_cite: nirnimittam bhavej jñānaṃ nirādhāram bhramātmakam | tattvataḥ kasyacin naitad evambhāvī śivaḥ priye

lines: Consciousness-natured, all bodies, no distinction:
made of that, contemplating all — world-conqueror.
vbt-p10-v100.sanskrit_cite: ciddharmā sarvadeheṣu viśeṣo nāsti kutracit | ataś ca tanmayaṃ sarvam bhāvayan bhavajij janaḥ

lines: Passion-range — lust, anger, greed, delusion, pride, envy:
uncaused intellect made there — reality remains.
vbt-p11-v101.sanskrit_cite: kāmakrodhalobhamohamadamātsaryagocare | buddhiṃ nistimitāṃ kṛtvā tat tattvam avaśiṣyate

lines: Indra-net world, cast, or picture-work-like, whirling:
meditating all, seeing all — joy upsurges.
vbt-p11-v102.sanskrit_cite: indrajālamayaṃ viśvaṃ vyastaṃ vā citrakarmavat | bhramad vā dhyāyataḥ sarvam paśyataś ca sukhodgamaḥ

lines: Not mind cast in pain, not joy, scattered nowhere:
Bhairavī — in middle what remains may be known.
vbt-p11-v103.sanskrit_cite: na cittaṃ nikṣiped duḥkhe na sukhe vā parikṣipet | bhairavi jñāyatāṃ madhye kiṃ tattvam avaśiṣyate

lines: Own-body-standing left, everywhere-I-am-thus:
firm mind, gaze seeing none else — happy may be.
vbt-p11-v104.sanskrit_cite: vihāya nijadehasthaṃ sarvatrāsmīti bhāvayan | dṛḍhena manasā dṛṣṭyā nānyekṣiṇyā sukhī bhavet

lines: Pot and such, knowing, desire and such, inside me:
never all-pervading born — all-going contemplating thus.
vbt-p11-v105.sanskrit_cite: ghaṭādau yac ca vijñānam icchādyaṃ vā mamāntare | naiva sarvagataṃ jātam bhāvayan iti sarvagaḥ

lines: Grasped-grasping awareness: all embodied common;
yogins' distinction: He-is — relation, carefulness.
vbt-p11-v106.sanskrit_cite: grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittiḥ sāmānyā sarvadehinām | yogināṃ tu viśeṣo =B9sti sambandhe sāvadhānatā

lines: Like self in other's body — He perceives awareness:
own-body-regard left — pervasive in days may be.
vbt-p11-v107.sanskrit_cite: svavad anyaśarīre =B9pi saṃvittim anubhāvayet | apekṣāṃ svaśarīrasya tyaktvā vyāpī dinair bhavet

lines: Supportless mind made — thoughts not to be thought:
in self-supreme-self — Bhairava, deer-eyed.
vbt-p11-v108.sanskrit_cite: nirādhāraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā vikalpān na vikalpayet | tadātmaparamātmatve bhairavo mṛgalocane

lines: All-knowing, all-doing, pervasive highest-Lord:
he indeed I — Śiva-natured, from firmness Śiva.
vbt-p11-v109.sanskrit_cite: sarvajñaḥ sarvakartā ca vyāpakaḥ parameśvaraḥ | sa evāhaṃ śaivadharmā iti dārḍhyāc chivo bhavet

lines: Water's waves, flame-plays of fire, sun's light:
mine and Bhairava's — world-plays manifest only.
vbt-p11-v110.sanskrit_cite: jalasyevormayo vahner jvālābhaṅgyaḥ prabhā raveḥ | mamaiva bhairavasyaitā viśvabhaṅgyo vibheditāḥ

lines: Whirled, whirled, body swiftly fallen earth-ward:
agitation-power ceasing — supreme state born.
vbt-p12-v111.sanskrit_cite: bhrāntvā bhrāntvā śarīreṇa tvaritam bhuvi pātanāt | kṣobhaśaktivirāmeṇa parā saṃjāyate daśā

lines: Supports or power, knowing, or mind-dissolving:
power-penetration's end — Bhairava form.
vbt-p12-v112.sanskrit_cite: ādhāreṣv athavā 'śaktyā 'jñānāc cittalayena vā | jātaśaktisamāveśakṣobhānte bhairavaṃ vapuḥ

lines: Tradition this, Goddess, hear — rightly I tell:
even freedom born at once — eyes unwinkering fixed.
vbt-p12-v113.sanskrit_cite: sampradāyam imam devi śṛṇu samyag vadāmy aham | kaivalyaṃ jāyate sadyo netrayoḥ stabdhamātrayoḥ

lines: Ear-contraction, at lower gate likewise:
unsmeared, unploughed, meditating — eternal brahman entered.
vbt-p12-v114.sanskrit_cite: saṃkocaṃ karṇayoḥ kṛtvā hy adhodvāre tathaiva ca | anackam ahalaṃ dhyāyan viśed brahma sanātanam

lines: Above well and great pit, standing, from looking:
undivided mind rightly — mind dissolving plainly.
vbt-p12-v115.sanskrit_cite: kūpādike mahāgarte sthitvopari nirīkṣaṇāt | avikalpamateḥ samyak sadyas cittalayaḥ sphuṭam

lines: Wherever mind — outside, inside, or even:
there Śiva-state, by pervasiveness: where would it go?
vbt-p12-v116.sanskrit_cite: yatra yatra mano yāti bāhye vābhyantare 'pi vā | tatra tatra śivāvāsthā vyāpakatvāt kva yāsyati

lines: Wherever eye-road — consciousness manifested, pervader's:
his, only-that-natured, cit-dissolving — full-selfness.
vbt-p12-v117.sanskrit_cite: yatra yatrākṣamārgeṇa caitanyaṃ vyajyate vibhoḥ | tasya tanmātradharmitvāc cillayād bharitātmatā

lines: Hunger's end, fear, grief, abyss, battle fled:
curiosity-thirst's end — reality-being-full state.
vbt-p12-v118.sanskrit_cite: kṣutādyante bhaye śoke gahvare vā raṇād drute | kutūhalekṣudhādyante brahmasattāmayī daśā

lines: Things remembered, seen, in place mind leave:
own body unsupported — lord spreads forth.
vbt-p12-v119.sanskrit_cite: vastuṣu smaryamāṇeṣu dṛṣṭe deśe manas tyajet | svaśarīraṃ nirādhāraṃ kṛtvā prasarati prabhuḥ

lines: Anywhere on thing placed — slowly gaze withdraw:
mind-with that knowing — Goddess, void-abode.
vbt-p12-v120.sanskrit_cite: kvacid vastuni vinyasya śanair dṛṣṭiṃ nivartayet | taj jñānaṃ cittasahitaṃ devi śūnyālāyo bhavet

lines: Devotion's excess, dispassionate mind arisen:
her, Śaṅkara's power — contemplate always: Śiva then.
vbt-p13-v121.sanskrit_cite: bhaktyudrekād viraktasya yādṛśī jāyate matiḥ | sā śaktiḥ śāṅkarī nityam bhavayet tāṃ tataḥ śivaḥ

lines: In inner things, in all things voidness:
her meditated even — known, becomes calm.
vbt-p13-v122.sanskrit_cite: vastvantare vedyamāne sarvavastuṣu śūnyatā | tām eva manasā dhyātvā vidito 'pi praśāmyati

lines: Slightly knowing remembered purity — Śambhu's view:
neither pure nor impure — thought-free, happy may be.
vbt-p13-v123.sanskrit_cite: kiṃcijjñair yā smṛtā śuddhiḥ sā śuddhiḥ śambhudarśane | na śucir hy aśucis tasmān nirvikalpaḥ sukhī bhavet

lines: Everywhere Bhairava-state, in common things even:
not beyond — nondual going.
vbt-p13-v124.sanskrit_cite: sarvatra bhairavo bhāvaḥ sāmānyeṣv api gocaraḥ | na ca tadvyatirekteṇa paro 'stīty advayā gatiḥ

lines: Same in enemy and friend, honor, dishonor:
brahma's fullness known — happy may be.
vbt-p13-v125.sanskrit_cite: samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca samo mānāvamānayoḥ || brahmaṇaḥ paripūrṇatvāt iti jñātvā sukhī bhavet

lines: No hatred contemplated anywhere, no passion:
free of both — brahman glides forth middle.
vbt-p13-v126.sanskrit_cite: na dveṣam bhāvayet kvāpi na rāgam bhāvayet kvacit | rāgadveṣavinirmuktau madhye brahma prasarpati

lines: Unknowable, ungraspable, void, gone to nonbeing:
all as Bhairava contemplated — at end awakening arises.
vbt-p13-v127.sanskrit_cite: yad avedyaṃ yad agrāhyaṃ yac chūnyaṃ yad abhāvagam | tat sarvam bhairavam bhāvyaṃ tadante bodhasambhavaḥ

lines: Eternal, supportless, void, pervasive, counting-free:
mind in outer sky made — into skyless enters.
vbt-p13-v128.sanskrit_cite: nitye nirāśraye śūnye vyāpake kalanojjhite | bāhyākāśe manaḥ kṛtvā nirākāśaṃ samāviśet

lines: Wherever mind — that, that by that at that moment:
non-standing left — waveless then may be.
vbt-p13-v129.sanskrit_cite: yatra yatra mano yāti tat tat tenaiva tatkṣaṇam | parityajyānavasthityā nistaraṅgas tato bhavet

lines: Fear resounds all, giving-all pervasive wholeness:
of Bhairava-word, constant uttering — Śiva.
vbt-p13-v130.sanskrit_cite: bhayā sarvaṃ ravayati sarvado vyāpako 'khile | iti bhairavaśabdasya santatoccāraṇāc chivaḥ

lines: 'I', 'mine', 'this' and such — conviction's doing:
supportless mind goes — meditation's impulse, calm.
vbt-p14-v131.sanskrit_cite: ahaṃ mamedam ityādi pratipattiprasaṅgataḥ | nirādhāre mano yāti taddhyānapreraṇāc chamī

lines: Eternal, all-pervading, supportless, all-lord:
words meditated moment by moment — meaning-aimed done.
vbt-p14-v132.sanskrit_cite: nityo vibhur nirādhāro vyāpakaś cākhilādhipaḥ | śabdān pratikṣaṇaṃ dhyāyan kṛtārtho 'rthānurūpataḥ

lines: Non-reality, Indra-net-shine, all standing:
what reality of net? From firmness — calm goes.
vbt-p14-v133.sanskrit_cite: atattvam indrajālābham idaṃ sarvam avasthitam | kiṃ tattvam indrajālasya iti dārḍhyāc chamaṃ vrajet

lines: Self unwavering — where knowing, where action?
knowing-dependent outer states — void, this world.
vbt-p14-v134.sanskrit_cite: ātmano nirvikārasya kva jñānaṃ kva ca vā kriyā | jñānāyattā bahirbhāvā ataḥ śūnyam idaṃ jagat

lines: Not of me bondage, not freedom — frightened's terrors:
this reflection of intellect in waters, sun's.
vbt-p14-v135.sanskrit_cite: na me bandho na mokṣo me bhītasyaitā vibhīṣikāḥ | pratibimbam idam buddher jaleṣv iva vivasvataḥ

lines: Sense-doored all, meeting pleasure pain and such:
senses left — self-abiding in own self abides.
vbt-p14-v136.sanskrit_cite: indriyadvārakaṃ sarvaṃ sukhaduḥkhādisaṃgamam | itīndriyāṇi saṃtyajya svasthaḥ svātmani vartate

lines: Knowing-lighting all, by all self lighting:
one from one-nature — knowing-knowable envisioned.
vbt-p14-v137.sanskrit_cite: jñānaprakāśakaṃ sarvaṃ sarveṇātmā prakāśakaḥ | ekam ekasvabhāvatvāt jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ vibhāvyate

lines: Mental, consciousness, power, self, mind — fourfold:
when wasted fully, O dear — then Bhairava form.
vbt-p14-v138.sanskrit_cite: mānasaṃ cetanā śaktir ātmā ceti catuṣṭayam | yadā priye parikṣīṇaṃ tadā tad bhairavaṃ vapuḥ

lines: Waveless teachings hundred told in brief, twelve-plus:
which knowing, O Goddess — knowing-knower person.
vbt-p14-v139.sanskrit_cite: nistaraṅgopadeśānāṃ śatam uktaṃ samāsataḥ | dvādaśābhyadhikaṃ devi yaj jñātvā jñānavij janaḥ

lines: Here and in one yoked — Bhairava himself becomes:
by speech deeds does — curse-and-favor making.
vbt-p14-v140.sanskrit_cite: atra caikatame yukto jāyate bhairavaḥ svayam | vācā karoti karmāṇi śāpānugrahakārakaḥ

lines: Ageless deathlessness he attains, atom-qualities endowed:
of yoginīs dear — the all-gathering lord.
vbt-p15-v141.sanskrit_cite: ajarāmaratām eti so 'ṇimādiguṇānvitaḥ | yoginīnām priyo devi sarvamelāpakādhipaḥ

lines: Living even, freed; acting even — not smeared:
this body — supreme great-lord's, O god.
vbt-p15-v142.sanskrit_cite: jīvann api vimukto 'sau kurvann api na lipyate | idaṃ yadi vapur deva parāyāś ca maheśvara

lines: In this state told — who mutes, who meditates, who worships?
who is pleased, O great lord?
vbt-p15-v143.sanskrit_cite: evamuktavyavasthāyāṃ japyate ko japaś ca kaḥ | dhyāyate ko mahānātha pūjyate kaś ca tṛpyati

lines: Whose oblation, whose sacrifice — what, and how?
outer procedure this, in gross things, deer-eyed.
vbt-p15-v144.sanskrit_cite: hūyate kasya vā homo yāgaḥ kasya ca kiṃ katham | eṣātra prakriyā bāhyā sthūleṣv eva mṛgekṣaṇe

lines: Again, again the supreme state — what contemplation contemplates:
muttering there: self-sound, mantra-natured, such.
vbt-p15-v145.sanskrit_cite: bhūyo bhūyaḥ pare bhāve bhāvanā bhāvyate hi yā | japaḥ so 'tra svayaṃ nādo mantrātmā japya īdṛśaḥ

lines: Meditation: unmoving intellect, formless, supportless;
not meditation: body-eye-mouth-hand imagining.
vbt-p15-v146.sanskrit_cite: dhyānaṃ hi niścalā buddhir nirākārā nirāśrayā | na tu dhyānaṃ śarīrākṣimukhahastādikalpanā

lines: Worship: not by flowers — mind made firm:
in undifferentiated great sky, from care dissolving.
vbt-p15-v147.sanskrit_cite: pūjā nāma na puṣpādyair yā matiḥ kriyate dṛḍhā | nirvikalpe mahāvyomni sā pūjā hy ādarāl layaḥ

lines: Here in one-yoking standing, from day to day:
full-formed state — contentment here, utter fullness.
vbt-p15-v148.sanskrit_cite: atraikatamayuktisthe yotpadyeta dinād dinam | bharitākāratā sātra tṛptir atyantapūrṇatā

lines: Great void-abode, in fire: sense-objects and such:
offered by mind, oblation all, awareness-ladle.
vbt-p15-v149.sanskrit_cite: mahāśūnyālaye vahnau bhūtākṣaviṣayādikam | hūyate manasā sārdhaṃ sa homaś cetanāsrucā

lines: Sacrifice here, highest lady — contentment, bliss-marked:
wasting all sins, protecting all — mountain's daughter.
vbt-p15-v150.sanskrit_cite: yāgo 'tra parameśāni tuṣṭir ānandalakṣaṇā | kṣapaṇāt sarvapāpānāṃ trāṇāt sarvasya pārvati

lines: Rudra-power-penetration: that field, contemplation supreme:
otherwise of it — what worship, which pleased?
vbt-p16-v151.sanskrit_cite: rudraśaktisamāveśas tat kṣetram bhāvanā parā | anyathā tasya tattvasya kā pūjā kāś ca tṛpyati

lines: Free-bliss-consciousness-mere-essence — self everywhere:
entering that form: own-self's bath, declared.
vbt-p16-v152.sanskrit_cite: svatantrānandacinmātrasāraḥ svātmā hi sarvataḥ | āveśanaṃ tatsvarūpe svātmanaḥ snānam īritam

lines: By which worshipped, materials please, or higher-lower:
who worshipper? all he, very one: where the worship?
vbt-p16-v153.sanskrit_cite: yair eva pūjyate dravyais tarpyate vā parāparaḥ | yaś caiva pūjakaḥ sarvaḥ sa evaikaḥ kva pūjanam

lines: Breath goes, life enters — will, crooked-formed:
long-formed she, great goddess: other field, higher-lower.
vbt-p16-v154.sanskrit_cite: vrajet prāṇo viśej jīva icchayā kuṭilākṛtiḥ | dīrghātmā sā mahādevī parakṣetram parāparā

lines: In this walking, standing in great-bliss-path:
by her entered — supreme Bhairava attained.
vbt-p16-v155.sanskrit_cite: asyām anucaran tiṣṭhan mahānandamaye 'dhvare | tayā devyā samāviṣṭaḥ param bhairavam āpnuyāt

lines: Six hundreds by day, thousand twenty-one by night:
goddess's muting declared — easy, hard for dull.
vbt-p16-v156.sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭśatāni divā rātrau sahasrāṇyekaviṃśatiḥ | japo devyāḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ sulabho durlabho jaḍaiḥ

lines: Thus told, Goddess — supreme nectar, highest:
never to be shown of anyone, but ever.
vbt-p16-v157.sanskrit_cite: ity etat kathitaṃ devi paramāmṛtam uttamam | etac ca naiva kasyāpi prakāśyaṃ tu kadācana

lines: To another pupil, base, cruel, non-devoted:
but to thought-free heroes, lofty-souled — guru's feet.
vbt-p16-v158.sanskrit_cite: paraśiṣye khale krūre abhakte gurupādayoḥ | nirvikalpamatīnāṃ tu vīrāṇām unnatātmanām

lines: To devotees, guru's company: given unhedged:
village, kingdom, town, country, son, wife, kin.
vbt-p16-v159.sanskrit_cite: bhaktānāṃ guruvargasya dātavyaṃ nirviśaṅkayā | grāmo rājyam puraṃ deśaḥ putradārakuṭumbakam

lines: All this left — grasped, this, deer-eyed:
unsteady what? steady this supreme wealth; lives given, nectar not.
vbt-p16-v160.sanskrit_cite: sarvam etat parityajya grāhyam etan mṛgekṣaṇe | kim ebhir asthirair devi sthiram param idaṃ dhanam | prāṇā api pradātavyā na deyaṃ paramāmṛtam

lines: God of gods, great god — content am I, Śaṅkara:
Rudrayāmala-tantra's essence, held today.
vbt-p17-v161.sanskrit_cite: devadeva māhadeva paritṛptāsmi śaṅkara | rudrayāmalatantrasya sāram adyāvadhāritam

lines: Heart of all power-divisions known today:
spoken, delighted — goddess on neck, to Śiva's clung.
vbt-p17-v162.sanskrit_cite: sarvaśaktiprabhedānāṃ hṛdayaṃ jñātam adya ca | ity uktvānanditā devi ka.ṅthe lagnā śivasya tu
